aboleth.special.1.name: Amphibious
aboleth.special.1.desc: The aboleth can breathe air and water.
aboleth.special.2.name: Mucous Cloud
aboleth.special.2.desc: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.
aboleth.special.3.name: Probing Telepathy
aboleth.special.3.desc: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.
aboleth.actions.1.name: Multiattack
aboleth.actions.1.desc: The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks.
aboleth.actions.2.name: Tentacle
aboleth.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can't regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed.
aboleth.actions.3.name: Tail
aboleth.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
aboleth.actions.4.name: Enslave
aboleth.actions.4.desc:
The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 ft. of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.
Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.
aboleth.legendary.1.name: Detect
aboleth.legendary.1.desc: The aboleth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.
aboleth.legendary.2.name: Tail Swipe
aboleth.legendary.2.desc: The aboleth makes one tail attack.
aboleth.legendary.3.name: Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
aboleth.legendary.3.desc: One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.
aboleth.name: Aboleth
acolyte.special.1.name: Spellcasting
acolyte.special.1.desc:
The acolyte is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The acolyte has following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (3 slots): bless, cure wounds, sanctuary
acolyte.actions.1.name: Club
acolyte.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.
acolyte.name: Acolyte
acolyte.desc: Acolytes are junior members of a clergy, usually answerable to a priest. They perform a variety of functions in a temple and are granted minor spellcasting power by their deities.

adult-white-dragon.actions.5.name: Frightful Presence
adult-white-dragon.actions.5.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 ft. of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. air-elemental.special.1.name: Air Form
air-elemental.special.1.desc: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

air-elemental.actions.1.desc: The elemental makes two slam attacks.
air-elemental.actions.2.name: Slam
air-elemental.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
air-elemental.actions.3.name: Whirlwind
air-elemental.actions.3.desc:
Each creature in the elemental's space must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and is flung up 20 feet away from the elemental in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes an object, such as a wall or floor, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.
If the saving throw is successful, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't flung away or knocked prone.

air-elemental.resistances: lightning; thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

ancient-red-dragon.actions.4.name: Tail
ancient-red-dragon.actions.4.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.
ancient-red-dragon.actions.5.name: Frightful Presence
ancient-red-dragon.actions.5.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.
ancient-red-dragon.actions.6.name: Fire Breath
ancient-red-dragon.actions.6.desc: The dragon exhales fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
ancient-red-dragon.legendary.1.name: Detect
ancient-red-dragon.legendary.1.desc: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.
ancient-red-dragon.legendary.2.name: Tail Attack
ancient-red-dragon.legendary.2.desc: The dragon makes a tail attack.
ancient-red-dragon.legendary.3.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
ancient-red-dragon.legendary.3.desc: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
ancient-red-dragon.name: Ancient Red Dragon
ancient-silver-dragon.special.1.name: Legendary Resistance
ancient-silver-dragon.special.1.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.2.name: Bite
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage.
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.3.name: Claw
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage.
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.4.name: Tail
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.4.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.5.name: Frightful Presence
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.5.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.6.name: Breath Weapons
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.6.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Cold Breath. The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 67 (15d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Paralyzing Breath. The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.7.name: Change Shape
ancient-silver-dragon.actions.7.desc:
The dragon magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the dragon's choice).
In a new form, the dragon retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.
ancient-silver-dragon.legendary.1.name: Detect
ancient-silver-dragon.legendary.1.desc: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.
ancient-silver-dragon.legendary.2.name: Tail Attack
ancient-silver-dragon.legendary.2.desc: The dragon makes a tail attack.
ancient-silver-dragon.legendary.3.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
ancient-silver-dragon.legendary.3.desc: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
ancient-silver-dragon.name: Ancient Silver Dragon
ancient-white-dragon.special.1.name: Ice Walk
ancient-white-dragon.special.1.desc: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.
ancient-white-dragon.special.2.name: Legendary Resistance
ancient-white-dragon.special.2.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
ancient-white-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ancient-white-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
ancient-white-dragon.actions.2.name: Bite
ancient-white-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.
ancient-white-dragon.actions.3.name: Claw
ancient-white-dragon.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.
ancient-white-dragon.actions.4.name: Tail
ancient-white-dragon.actions.4.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
ancient-white-dragon.actions.5.name: Frightful Presence
ancient-white-dragon.actions.5.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours .
ancient-white-dragon.actions.6.name: Cold Breath
ancient-white-dragon.actions.6.desc: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 72 (16d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
ancient-white-dragon.legendary.1.name: Detect
ancient-white-dragon.legendary.1.desc: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.
ancient-white-dragon.legendary.2.name: Tail Attack
ancient-white-dragon.legendary.2.desc: The dragon makes a tail attack.
ancient-white-dragon.legendary.3.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
ancient-white-dragon.legendary.3.desc: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
ancient-white-dragon.name: Ancient White Dragon
androsphinx.special.1.name: Inscrutable
androsphinx.special.1.desc: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
androsphinx.special.2.name: Magic Weapons
androsphinx.special.2.desc: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.
androsphinx.special.3.name: Spellcasting
androsphinx.special.3.desc:
The sphinx is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no material components to cast its spells. The sphinx has the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): sacred flame, spare the dying, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (4 slots): command, detect evil and good, detect magic
- 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, zone of truth
- 3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, tongues
- 4th level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement
- 5th level (2 slots): flame strike, greater restoration
- 6th level (1 slot): heroes' feast
androsphinx.actions.1.name: Multiattack
androsphinx.actions.1.desc: The sphinx makes two claw attacks.
androsphinx.actions.2.name: Claw
androsphinx.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.
androsphinx.actions.3.name: Roar
androsphinx.actions.3.desc:
The sphinx emits a magical roar. Each time it roars before finishing a long rest, the roar is louder and the effect is different, as detailed below. Each creature within 500 feet of the sphinx and able to hear the roar must make a saving throw.

First Roar. Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Second Roar. Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is deafened and frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature is paralyzed and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Third Roar. Each creature makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) thunder damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.
androsphinx.legendary.1.name: Claw Attack
androsphinx.legendary.1.desc: The sphinx makes one claw attack.
androsphinx.legendary.2.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
androsphinx.legendary.2.desc: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
androsphinx.legendary.3.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
androsphinx.legendary.3.desc: The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.
androsphinx.name: Androsphinx
androsphinx.immunities: psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
animated-armor.special.1.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
animated-armor.special.1.desc: The armor is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the armor must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.
animated-armor.special.2.name: False Appearance
animated-armor.special.2.desc: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.
animated-armor.actions.1.name: Multiattack
animated-armor.actions.1.desc: The armor makes two melee attacks.
animated-armor.actions.2.name: Slam
animated-armor.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
animated-armor.name: Animated Armor
ankheg.actions.1.name: Bite
ankheg.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the ankheg can bite only the grappled creature and has advantage on attack rolls to do so.
ankheg.actions.2.name: Acid Spray
ankheg.actions.2.desc: The ankheg spits acid in a line that is 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide, provided that it has no creature grappled. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
ankheg.name: Ankheg
ape.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ape.actions.1.desc: The ape makes two fist attacks.
ape.actions.2.name: Fist
ape.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
ape.actions.3.name: Rock
ape.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 25/50 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
ape.name: Ape
archmage.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
archmage.special.1.desc: The archmage has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
archmage.special.2.name: Spellcasting
archmage.special.2.desc:
The archmage is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The archmage can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, shocking grasp
- 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, identify, mage armor*, magic missile
- 2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, mirror image, misty step
- 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fly, lightning bolt
- 4th level (3 slots): banishment, fire shield, stoneskin*
- 5th level (3 slots): cone of cold, scrying, wall of force
- 6th level (1 slot): globe of invulnerability
- 7th level (1 slot): teleport
- 8th level (1 slot): mind blank*
- 9th level (1 slot): time stop
* The archmage casts these spells on itself before combat.
archmage.actions.1.name: Dagger
archmage.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
archmage.name: Archmage
archmage.desc:
Archmages are powerful (and usually quite old) spellcasters dedicated to the study of the arcane arts. Benevolent ones counsel kings and queens, while evil ones rule as tyrants and pursue lichdom. Those who are neither good nor evil sequester themselves in remote towers to practice their magic without interruption. 

An archmage typically has one or more apprentice mages, and an archmage’s abode has numerous magical wards and guardians to discourage interlopers.
archmage.resistances: damage from spells; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks (from stoneskin)
assassin.special.1.name: Assassinate
assassin.special.1.desc: During its first turn, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
assassin.special.2.name: Evasion
assassin.special.2.desc: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.
assassin.special.3.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
assassin.special.3.desc: The assassin deals an extra 13 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the assassin that isn't incapacitated and the assassin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.
assassin.actions.1.name: Multiattack
assassin.actions.1.desc: The assassin makes two shortsword attacks.
assassin.actions.2.name: Shortsword
assassin.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
assassin.actions.3.name: Light Crossbow
assassin.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.desc: Trained in the use of poison, assassins are remorseless killers who work for nobles, guildmasters, sovereigns, and anyone else who can afford them.
assassin.languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages
awakened-shrub.special.1.name: False Appearance
awakened-shrub.special.1.desc: While the shrub remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.
awakened-shrub.actions.1.name: Rake
awakened-shrub.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) slashing damage.
awakened-shrub.name: Awakened Shrub
awakened-shrub.desc: An awakened shrub is an ordinary shrub given sentience and mobility by the awaken spell or similar magic.
awakened-shrub.languages: one language known by its creator
awakened-tree.special.1.name: False Appearance
awakened-tree.special.1.desc: While the tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.
awakened-tree.actions.1.name: Slam
awakened-tree.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
awakened-tree.name: Awakened Tree
awakened-tree.desc: An awakened tree is an ordinary tree given sentience and mobility by the awaken spell or similar magic.
awakened-tree.languages: one language known by its creator
axe-beak.actions.1.name: Beak
axe-beak.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.
axe-beak.name: Axe Beak
axe-beak.desc: An axe beak is a tall flightless bird with strong legs and a heavy, wedge-shaped beak. It has a nasty disposition and tends to attack any unfamiliar creature that wanders too close.
azer.special.1.name: Heated Body
azer.special.1.desc: A creature that touches the azer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.
azer.special.2.name: Heated Weapons
azer.special.2.desc: When the azer hits with a metal melee weapon, it deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage (included in the attack).
azer.special.3.name: Illumination
azer.special.3.desc: The azer sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 ft..
azer.actions.1.name: Warhammer
azer.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
azer.name: Azer
baboon.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
baboon.special.1.desc: The baboon has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
baboon.actions.1.name: Bite
baboon.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.
baboon.name: Baboon
badger.special.1.name: Keen Smell
badger.special.1.desc: The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
badger.actions.1.name: Bite
badger.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
badger.name: Badger
balor.special.1.name: Death Throes
balor.special.1.desc: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried, and it destroys the balor's weapons.
balor.special.2.name: Fire Aura
balor.special.2.desc: At the start of each of the balor's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the balor or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.
balor.special.3.name: Magic Resistance
balor.special.3.desc: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
balor.special.4.name: Magic Weapons
balor.special.4.desc: The balor's weapon attacks are magical.
balor.actions.1.name: Multiattack
balor.actions.1.desc: The balor makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its whip.
balor.actions.2.name: Longsword
balor.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If the balor scores a critical hit, it rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.
balor.actions.3.name: Whip
balor.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor.
balor.actions.4.name: Teleport
balor.actions.4.desc: The balor magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
balor.name: Balor
balor.resistances: cold; lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
bandit.actions.1.name: Scimitar
bandit.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
bandit.actions.2.name: Light Crossbow
bandit.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
bandit.name: Bandit
bandit.desc:
**Bandits** rove in gangs and are sometimes led by thugs, veterans, or spellcasters. Not all bandits are evil. Oppression, drought, disease, or famine can often drive otherwise honest folk to a life of banditry.

**Pirates** are bandits of the high seas. They might be freebooters interested only in treasure and murder, or they might be privateers sanctioned by the crown to attack and plunder an enemy nation’s vessels.
bandit-captain.actions.1.name: Multiattack
bandit-captain.actions.1.desc: The captain makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or the captain makes two ranged attacks with its daggers.
bandit-captain.actions.2.name: Scimitar
bandit-captain.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
bandit-captain.actions.3.name: Dagger
bandit-captain.actions.3.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
bandit-captain.reactions.1.name: Parry
bandit-captain.reactions.1.desc: The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the captain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
bandit-captain.name: Bandit Captain
bandit-captain.desc:
It takes a strong personality, ruthless cunning, and a silver tongue to keep a gang of bandits in line. The **bandit captain** has these qualities in spades.

In addition to managing a crew of selfish malcontents, the **pirate captain** is a variation of the bandit captain, with a ship to protect and command. To keep the crew in line, the captain must mete out rewards and punishment on a regular basis.

More than treasure, a bandit captain or pirate captain craves infamy. A prisoner who appeals to the captain’s vanity or ego is more likely to be treated fairly than a prisoner who does not or claims not to know anything of the captain’s colorful reputation.
barbed-devil.special.1.name: Barbed Hide
barbed-devil.special.1.desc: At the start of each of its turns, the barbed devil deals 5 (1d10) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.
barbed-devil.special.2.name: Devil's Sight
barbed-devil.special.2.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.
barbed-devil.special.3.name: Magic Resistance
barbed-devil.special.3.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
barbed-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
barbed-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes three melee attacks: one with its tail and two with its claws. Alternatively, it can use Hurl Flame twice.
barbed-devil.actions.2.name: Claw
barbed-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
barbed-devil.actions.3.name: Tail
barbed-devil.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
barbed-devil.actions.4.name: Hurl Flame
barbed-devil.actions.4.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.
barbed-devil.name: Barbed Devil
barbed-devil.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
basilisk.special.1.name: Petrifying Gaze
basilisk.special.1.desc:
If a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. of the basilisk and the two of them can see each other, the basilisk can force the creature to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw if the basilisk isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.
A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the basilisk in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the basilisk sees its reflection within 30 ft. of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.
basilisk.actions.1.name: Bite
basilisk.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
basilisk.name: Basilisk
bat.special.1.name: Echolocation
bat.special.1.desc: The bat can't use its blindsight while deafened.
bat.special.2.name: Keen Hearing
bat.special.2.desc: The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
bat.actions.1.name: Bite
bat.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
bat.name: Bat
bearded-devil.special.1.name: Devil's Sight
bearded-devil.special.1.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.
bearded-devil.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
bearded-devil.special.2.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
bearded-devil.special.3.name: Steadfast
bearded-devil.special.3.desc: The devil can't be frightened while it can see an allied creature within 30 feet of it.
bearded-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
bearded-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes two attacks: one with its beard and one with its glaive.
bearded-devil.actions.2.name: Beard
bearded-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target can't regain hit points. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
bearded-devil.actions.3.name: Glaive
bearded-devil.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or lose 5 (1d10) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time the devil hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 5 (1d10). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.
bearded-devil.name: Bearded Devil
bearded-devil.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
behir.actions.1.name: Multiattack
behir.actions.1.desc: The behir makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.
behir.actions.2.name: Bite
behir.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.
behir.actions.3.name: Constrict
behir.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the behir isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.
behir.actions.4.name: Lightning Breath
behir.actions.4.desc: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
behir.actions.5.name: Swallow
behir.actions.5.desc:
The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time.
If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 ft. of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 ft. of movement, exiting prone.
behir.name: Behir
berserker.special.1.name: Reckless
berserker.special.1.desc: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
berserker.actions.1.name: Greataxe
berserker.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.
berserker.name: Berserker
black-bear.special.1.name: Keen Smell
black-bear.special.1.desc: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
black-bear.actions.1.name: Multiattack
black-bear.actions.1.desc: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
black-bear.actions.2.name: Bite
black-bear.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
black-bear.actions.3.name: Claws
black-bear.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
black-bear.name: Black Bear
black-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.name: Amphibious
black-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Bite
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage.
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Acid Breath
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc: The dragon exhales acid in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
black-dragon-wyrmling.name: Black Dragon Wyrmling
black-pudding.special.1.name: Amorphous
black-pudding.special.1.desc: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
black-pudding.special.2.name: Corrosive Form
black-pudding.special.2.desc: A creature that touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the pudding corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage. The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.
black-pudding.special.3.name: Spider Climb
black-pudding.special.3.desc: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
black-pudding.actions.1.name: Pseudopod
black-pudding.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.
black-pudding.reactions.1.name: Split
black-pudding.reactions.1.desc: When a pudding that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new puddings if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new pudding has hit points equal to half the original pudding's, rounded down. New puddings are one size smaller than the original pudding.
black-pudding.name: Black Pudding
blink-dog.special.1.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
blink-dog.special.1.desc: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
blink-dog.actions.1.name: Bite
blink-dog.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
blink-dog.actions.2.name: Teleport
blink-dog.actions.2.desc: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.
blink-dog.name: Blink Dog
blink-dog.desc: A blink dog takes its name from its ability to blink in and out of existence, a talent it uses to aid its attacks and to avoid harm.
blink-dog.languages: Blink Dog, understands Sylvan but can't speak it
blood-hawk.special.1.name: Keen Sight
blood-hawk.special.1.desc: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
blood-hawk.special.2.name: Pack Tactics
blood-hawk.special.2.desc: The hawk has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hawk's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
blood-hawk.actions.1.name: Beak
blood-hawk.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
blood-hawk.name: Blood Hawk
blood-hawk.desc: Taking its name from its crimson feathers and aggressive nature, the blood hawk fearlessly attacks almost any animal, stabbing it with its daggerlike beak. Blood hawks flock together in large numbers, attacking as a pack to take down prey.
blue-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Bite
blue-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.
blue-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Lightning Breath
blue-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc: The dragon exhales lightning in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
blue-dragon-wyrmling.name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling
boar.special.1.name: Charge
boar.special.1.desc: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
boar.special.2.name: Relentless
boar.special.2.desc: If the boar takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.
boar.actions.1.name: Tusk
boar.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
boar.name: Boar
bone-devil.special.1.name: Devil's Sight
bone-devil.special.1.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.
bone-devil.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
bone-devil.special.2.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
bone-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
bone-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.
bone-devil.actions.2.name: Claw
bone-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
bone-devil.actions.3.name: Sting
bone-devil.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
bone-devil.name: Bone Devil
bone-devil.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
brass-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Bite
brass-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
brass-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Breath Weapons
brass-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Fire Breath. The dragon exhales fire in an 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Sleep Breath. The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.
brass-dragon-wyrmling.name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling
bronze-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.name: Amphibious
bronze-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
bronze-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Bite
bronze-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
bronze-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Breath Weapons
bronze-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Lightning Breath. The dragon exhales lightning in a 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Repulsion Breath. The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 30 feet away from the dragon.
bronze-dragon-wyrmling.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling
brown-bear.special.1.name: Keen Smell
brown-bear.special.1.desc: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
brown-bear.actions.1.name: Multiattack
brown-bear.actions.1.desc: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
brown-bear.actions.2.name: Bite
brown-bear.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
brown-bear.actions.3.name: Claws
brown-bear.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
brown-bear.name: Brown Bear
bugbear.special.1.name: Brute
bugbear.special.1.desc: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bugbear hits with it (included in the attack).
bugbear.special.2.name: Surprise Attack
bugbear.special.2.desc: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.
bugbear.actions.1.name: Morningstar
bugbear.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
bugbear.actions.2.name: Javelin
bugbear.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage in melee or 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage at range.
bugbear.name: Bugbear
bulette.special.1.name: Standing Leap
bulette.special.1.desc: The bulette's long jump is up to 30 ft. and its high jump is up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.
bulette.actions.1.name: Bite
bulette.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.
bulette.actions.2.name: Deadly Leap
bulette.actions.2.desc: If the bulette jumps at least 15 ft. as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 ft. out of the bulette's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the bulette's space.
bulette.name: Bulette
camel.actions.1.name: Bite
camel.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.
camel.name: Camel
cat.special.1.name: Keen Smell
cat.special.1.desc: The cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
cat.actions.1.name: Claws
cat.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.
cat.name: Cat
centaur.special.1.name: Charge
centaur.special.1.desc: If the centaur moves at least 30 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.
centaur.actions.1.name: Multiattack
centaur.actions.1.desc: The centaur makes two attacks: one with its pike and one with its hooves or two with its longbow.
centaur.actions.2.name: Pike
centaur.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
centaur.actions.3.name: Hooves
centaur.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
centaur.actions.4.name: Longbow
centaur.actions.4.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
centaur.name: Centaur
chain-devil.special.1.name: Devil's Sight
chain-devil.special.1.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.
chain-devil.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
chain-devil.special.2.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
chain-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
chain-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes two attacks with its chains.
chain-devil.actions.2.name: Chain
chain-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 14) if the devil isn't already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.
chain-devil.actions.3.name: Animate Chains
chain-devil.actions.3.desc:
Up to four chains the devil can see within 60 feet of it magically sprout razor-edged barbs and animate under the devil's control, provided that the chains aren't being worn or carried.
Each animated chain is an object with AC 20, 20 hit points, resistance to piercing damage, and immunity to psychic and thunder damage. When the devil uses Multiattack on its turn, it can use each animated chain to make one additional chain attack. An animated chain can grapple one creature of its own but can't make attacks while grappling. An animated chain reverts to its inanimate state if reduced to 0 hit points or if the devil is incapacitated or dies.
chain-devil.reactions.1.name: Unnerving Mask
chain-devil.reactions.1.desc: When a creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil, the devil can create the illusion that it looks like one of the creature's departed loved ones or bitter enemies. If the creature can see the devil, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its turn.
chain-devil.name: Chain Devil
chain-devil.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
chimera.actions.1.name: Multiattack
chimera.actions.1.desc: The chimera makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its horns, and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite or horns.
chimera.actions.2.name: Bite
chimera.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
chimera.actions.3.name: Horns
chimera.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
chimera.actions.4.name: Claws
chimera.actions.4.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
chimera.actions.5.name: Fire Breath
chimera.actions.5.desc: The dragon head exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
chimera.name: Chimera
chuul.special.1.name: Amphibious
chuul.special.1.desc: The chuul can breathe air and water.
chuul.special.2.name: Sense Magic
chuul.special.2.desc: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.
chuul.actions.1.name: Multiattack
chuul.actions.1.desc: The chuul makes two pincer attacks. If the chuul is grappling a creature, the chuul can also use its tentacles once.
chuul.actions.2.name: Pincer
chuul.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the chuul doesn't have two other creatures grappled.
chuul.actions.3.name: Tentacles
chuul.actions.3.desc: One creature grappled by the chuul must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
chuul.name: Chuul
chuul.languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak
clay-golem.special.1.name: Acid Absorption
clay-golem.special.1.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.
clay-golem.special.2.name: Berserk
clay-golem.special.2.desc: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 60 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.
clay-golem.special.3.name: Immutable Form
clay-golem.special.3.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.
clay-golem.special.4.name: Magic Resistance
clay-golem.special.4.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
clay-golem.special.5.name: Magic Weapons
clay-golem.special.5.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.
clay-golem.actions.1.name: Multiattack
clay-golem.actions.1.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.
clay-golem.actions.2.name: Slam
clay-golem.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.
clay-golem.actions.3.name: Haste
clay-golem.actions.3.desc: Until the end of its next turn, the golem magically gains a +2 bonus to its AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and can use its slam attack as a bonus action.
clay-golem.name: Clay Golem
clay-golem.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
clay-golem.immunities: acid; poison; psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
cloaker.special.1.name: Damage Transfer
cloaker.special.1.desc: While attached to a creature, the cloaker takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down). and that creature takes the other half.
cloaker.special.2.name: False Appearance
cloaker.special.2.desc: While the cloaker remains motionless without its underside exposed, it is indistinguishable from a dark leather cloak.
cloaker.special.3.name: Light Sensitivity
cloaker.special.3.desc: While in bright light, the cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
cloaker.actions.1.name: Multiattack
cloaker.actions.1.desc: The cloaker makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.
cloaker.actions.2.name: Bite
cloaker.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the cloaker attaches to it. If the cloaker has advantage against the target, the cloaker attaches to the target's head, and the target is blinded and unable to breathe while the cloaker is attached. While attached, the cloaker can make this attack only against the target and has advantage on the attack roll. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the cloaker by succeeding on a DC 16 Strength check.
cloaker.actions.3.name: Tail
cloaker.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
cloaker.actions.4.name: Moan
cloaker.actions.4.desc: Each creature within 60 feet of the cloaker that can hear its moan and that isn't an aberration must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the cloaker's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the cloaker's moan for the next 24 hours.
cloaker.actions.5.name: Phantasms
cloaker.actions.5.desc:
The cloaker magically creates three illusory duplicates of itself if it isn't in bright light. The duplicates move with it and mimic its actions, shifting position so as to make it impossible to track which cloaker is the real one. If the cloaker is ever in an area of bright light, the duplicates disappear.
Whenever any creature targets the cloaker with an attack or a harmful spell while a duplicate remains, that creature rolls randomly to determine whether it targets the cloaker or one of the duplicates. A creature is unaffected by this magical effect if it can't see or if it relies on senses other than sight.
A duplicate has the cloaker's AC and uses its saving throws. If an attack hits a duplicate, or if a duplicate fails a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, the duplicate disappears.
cloaker.name: Cloaker
cloud-giant.special.1.name: Keen Smell
cloud-giant.special.1.desc: The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
cloud-giant.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
cloud-giant.special.2.desc:
The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect magic, fog cloud, light
3/day each: feather fall, fly, misty step, telekinesis
1/day each: control weather, gaseous form
cloud-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
cloud-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two morningstar attacks.
cloud-giant.actions.2.name: Morningstar
cloud-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage.
cloud-giant.actions.3.name: Rock
cloud-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
cloud-giant.name: Cloud Giant
cockatrice.actions.1.name: Bite
cockatrice.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw against being magically petrified. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified for 24 hours.
cockatrice.name: Cockatrice
commoner.actions.1.name: Club
commoner.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.
commoner.name: Commoner
commoner.desc: Commoners include peasants, serfs, slaves, servants, pilgrims, merchants, artisans, and hermits.
constrictor-snake.actions.1.name: Bite
constrictor-snake.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
constrictor-snake.actions.2.name: Constrict
constrictor-snake.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the snake can't constrict another target.
constrictor-snake.name: Constrictor Snake
copper-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Bite
copper-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
copper-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Breath Weapons
copper-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Acid Breath. The dragon exhales acid in an 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Slowing Breath. The dragon exhales gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.
copper-dragon-wyrmling.name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling
couatl.special.1.name: Innate Spellcasting
couatl.special.1.desc:
The couatl's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, detect thoughts
3/day each: bless, create food and water, cure wounds, lesser restoration, protection from poison, sanctuary, shield
1/day each: dream, greater restoration, scrying
couatl.special.2.name: Magic Weapons
couatl.special.2.desc: The couatl's weapon attacks are magical.
couatl.special.3.name: Shielded Mind
couatl.special.3.desc: The couatl is immune to scrying and to any effect that would sense its emotions, read its thoughts, or detect its location.
couatl.actions.1.name: Bite
couatl.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 24 hours. Until this poison ends, the target is unconscious. Another creature can use an action to shake the target awake.
couatl.actions.2.name: Constrict
couatl.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the couatl can't constrict another target.
couatl.actions.3.name: Change Shape
couatl.actions.3.desc:
The couatl magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the couatl's choice).
In a new form, the couatl retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and other actions are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks. If the new form has a bite attack, the couatl can use its bite in that form.
couatl.name: Couatl
couatl.immunities: psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
crab.special.1.name: Amphibious
crab.special.1.desc: The crab can breathe air and water.
crab.actions.1.name: Claw
crab.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.
crab.name: Crab
crocodile.special.1.name: Hold Breath
crocodile.special.1.desc: The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
crocodile.actions.1.name: Bite
crocodile.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can't bite another target
crocodile.name: Crocodile
cult-fanatic.special.1.name: Dark Devotion
cult-fanatic.special.1.desc: The fanatic has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.
cult-fanatic.special.2.name: Spellcasting
cult-fanatic.special.2.desc:
The fanatic is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spell casting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). The fanatic has the following cleric spells prepared:

Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (4 slots): command, inflict wounds, shield of faith
- 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, spiritual weapon
cult-fanatic.actions.1.name: Multiattack
cult-fanatic.actions.1.desc: The fanatic makes two melee attacks.
cult-fanatic.actions.2.name: Dagger
cult-fanatic.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
cult-fanatic.name: Cult Fanatic
cult-fanatic.desc: Fanatics are often part of a cult’s leadership, using their charisma and dogma to influence and prey on those of weak will. Most are interested in personal power above all else.
cultist.special.1.name: Dark Devotion
cultist.special.1.desc: The cultist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.
cultist.actions.1.name: Scimitar
cultist.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
cultist.name: Cultist
cultist.desc: Cultists swear allegiance to dark powers such as elemental princes, demon lords, or archdevils. Most conceal their loyalties to avoid being ostracized, imprisoned, or executed for their beliefs. Unlike evil acolytes, cultists often show signs of insanity in their beliefs and practices.
darkmantle.special.1.name: Echolocation
darkmantle.special.1.desc: The darkmantle can't use its blindsight while deafened.
darkmantle.special.2.name: False Appearance
darkmantle.special.2.desc: While the darkmantle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.
darkmantle.actions.1.name: Crush
darkmantle.actions.1.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is Medium or smaller and the darkmantle has advantage on the attack roll, it attaches by engulfing the target's head, and the target is also blinded and unable to breathe while the darkmantle is attached in this way.
While attached to the target, the darkmantle can attack no other creature except the target but has advantage on its attack rolls. The darkmantle's speed also becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed, and it moves with the target.
A creature can detach the darkmantle by making a successful DC 13 Strength check as an action. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself from the target by using 5 feet of movement.
darkmantle.actions.2.name: Darkness Aura
darkmantle.actions.2.desc: A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends out from the darkmantle, moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as the darkmantle maintains concentration, up to 10 minutes (as if concentrating on a spell). Darkvision can't penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.
darkmantle.name: Darkmantle
death-dog.special.1.name: Two-Headed
death-dog.special.1.desc: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.
death-dog.actions.1.name: Multiattack
death-dog.actions.1.desc: The dog makes two bite attacks.
death-dog.actions.2.name: Bite
death-dog.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the creature must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0.
death-dog.name: Death Dog
death-dog.desc: A death dog is an ugly two-headed hound that roams plains, and deserts. Hate burns in a death dog’s heart, and a taste for humanoid flesh drives it to attack travelers and explorers. Death dog saliva carries a foul disease that causes a victim’s flesh to slowly rot off the bone.
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.special.1.name: Stone Camouflage
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.special.1.desc: The gnome has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.special.2.name: Gnome Cunning
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.special.2.desc: The gnome has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.special.3.name: Innate Spellcasting
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.special.3.desc:
The gnome's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: nondetection (self only)
1/day each: blindness/deafness, blur, disguise self
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.actions.1.name: War Pick
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.actions.2.name: Poisoned Dart
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success
deep-gnome-svirfneblin.name: Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)
deer.actions.1.name: Bite
deer.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
deer.name: Deer
deva.special.1.name: Angelic Weapons
deva.special.1.desc: The deva's weapon attacks are magical. When the deva hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).
deva.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
deva.special.2.desc:
The deva's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The deva can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:
At will: detect evil and good
1/day each: commune, raise dead
deva.special.3.name: Magic Resistance
deva.special.3.desc: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
deva.actions.1.name: Multiattack
deva.actions.1.desc: The deva makes two melee attacks.
deva.actions.2.name: Mace
deva.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.
deva.actions.3.name: Healing Touch
deva.actions.3.desc: The deva touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.
deva.actions.4.name: Change Shape
deva.actions.4.desc:
The deva magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice).
In a new form, the deva retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.
deva.name: Deva
deva.resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
dire-wolf.special.1.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
dire-wolf.special.1.desc: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
dire-wolf.special.2.name: Pack Tactics
dire-wolf.special.2.desc: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
dire-wolf.actions.1.name: Bite
dire-wolf.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf
djinni.special.1.name: Elemental Demise
djinni.special.1.desc: If the djinni dies, its body disintegrates into a warm breeze, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying.
djinni.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
djinni.special.2.desc:
The djinni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, thunderwave
3/day each: create food and water (can create wine instead of water), tongues, wind walk
1/day each: conjure elemental (air elemental only), creation, gaseous form, invisibility, major image, plane shift
djinni.actions.1.name: Multiattack
djinni.actions.1.desc: The djinni makes three scimitar attacks.
djinni.actions.2.name: Scimitar
djinni.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning or thunder damage (djinni's choice).
djinni.actions.3.name: Create Whirlwind
djinni.actions.3.desc:
A 5-foot-radius, 30-foot-tall cylinder of swirling air magically forms on a point the djinni can see within 120 feet of it. The whirlwind lasts as long as the djinni maintains concentration (as if concentrating on a spell). Any creature but the djinni that enters the whirlwind must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be restrained by it. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 60 feet as an action, and creatures restrained by the whirlwind move with it. The whirlwind ends if the djinni loses sight of it.
A creature can use its action to free a creature restrained by the whirlwind, including itself, by succeeding on a DC 18 Strength check. If the check succeeds, the creature is no longer restrained and moves to the nearest space outside the whirlwind.
djinni.name: Djinni
doppelganger.special.1.name: Shapechanger
doppelganger.special.1.desc: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
doppelganger.special.2.name: Ambusher
doppelganger.special.2.desc: In the first round of combat, the doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.
doppelganger.special.3.name: Surprise Attack
doppelganger.special.3.desc: If the doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.
doppelganger.actions.1.name: Multiattack
doppelganger.actions.1.desc: The doppelganger makes two melee attacks.
doppelganger.actions.2.name: Slam
doppelganger.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
doppelganger.actions.3.name: Read Thoughts
doppelganger.actions.3.desc: The doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 ft. of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 ft. of wood or dirt, 2 ft. of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the doppelganger can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the doppelganger's concentration isn't broken (as if concentrating on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the doppelganger has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.
doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
draft-horse.actions.1.name: Hooves
draft-horse.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
draft-horse.name: Draft Horse
dragon-turtle.special.1.name: Amphibious
dragon-turtle.special.1.desc: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.
dragon-turtle.actions.1.name: Multiattack
dragon-turtle.actions.1.desc: The dragon turtle makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks.
dragon-turtle.actions.2.name: Bite
dragon-turtle.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage.
dragon-turtle.actions.3.name: Claw
dragon-turtle.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.
dragon-turtle.actions.4.name: Tail
dragon-turtle.actions.4.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon turtle and knocked prone.
dragon-turtle.actions.5.name: Steam Breath
dragon-turtle.actions.5.desc: The dragon turtle exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage.
dragon-turtle.name: Dragon Turtle
dretch.actions.1.name: Multiattack
dretch.actions.1.desc: The dretch makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
dretch.actions.2.name: Bite
dretch.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.
dretch.actions.3.name: Claws
dretch.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage.
dretch.actions.4.name: Fetid Cloud
dretch.actions.4.desc: A 10-foot radius of disgusting green gas extends out from the dretch. The gas spreads around corners, and its area is lightly obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it. Any creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both, and can't take reactions.
dretch.name: Dretch
dretch.languages: Abyssal, telepathy 60 ft. (works only with creatures that understand Abyssal)
drider.special.1.name: Fey Ancestry
drider.special.1.desc: The drider has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drider to sleep.
drider.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
drider.special.2.desc:
The drider's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13). The drider can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights
1/day each: darkness, faerie fire
drider.special.3.name: Spider Climb
drider.special.3.desc: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
drider.special.4.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
drider.special.4.desc: While in sunlight, the drider has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
drider.special.5.name: Web Walker
drider.special.5.desc: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
drider.actions.1.name: Multiattack
drider.actions.1.desc: The drider makes three attacks, either with its longsword or its longbow. It can replace one of those attacks with a bite attack.
drider.actions.2.name: Bite
drider.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.
drider.actions.3.name: Longsword
drider.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.
drider.actions.4.name: Longbow
drider.actions.4.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
drider.name: Drider
drow.special.1.name: Fey Ancestry
