drow.special.1.desc: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.
drow.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
drow.special.2.desc:
The drow's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights
1/day each: darkness, faerie fire
drow.special.3.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
drow.special.3.desc: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
drow.actions.1.name: Shortsword
drow.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
drow.actions.2.name: Hand Crossbow
drow.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
drow.name: Drow
druid.special.1.name: Spellcasting
druid.special.1.desc:
The druid is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh
- 1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave
- 2nd level (3 slots): animal messenger, barkskin
druid.actions.1.name: Quarterstaff
druid.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.
druid.name: Druid
druid.desc: **Druids** dwell in forests and other secluded wilderness locations, where they protect the natural world from monsters and the encroachment of civilization. Some are **tribal shamans** who heal the sick, pray to animal spirits, and provide spiritual guidance.
dryad.special.1.name: Innate Spellcasting
dryad.special.1.desc:
The dryad's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The dryad can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: druidcraft
3/day each: entangle, goodberry
1/day each: barkskin, pass without trace, shillelagh
dryad.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
dryad.special.2.desc: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
dryad.special.3.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
dryad.special.3.desc: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.
dryad.special.4.name: Tree Stride
dryad.special.4.desc: Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 ft. of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 ft. of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the second tree. Both trees must be large or bigger.
dryad.actions.1.name: Club
dryad.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+6 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.
dryad.actions.2.name: Fey Charm
dryad.actions.2.desc:
The dryad targets one humanoid or beast that she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see the dryad, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed. The charmed creature regards the dryad as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the dryad's control, it takes the dryad's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can.
Each time the dryad or its allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the dryad dies, is on a different plane of existence from the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action. If a target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the dryad's Fey Charm for the next 24 hours.
The dryad can have no more than one humanoid and up to three beasts charmed at a time.
dryad.name: Dryad
duergar.special.1.name: Duergar Resilience
duergar.special.1.desc: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.
duergar.special.2.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
duergar.special.2.desc: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
duergar.actions.1.name: Enlarge
duergar.actions.1.desc: For 1 minute, the duergar magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the duergar is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.
duergar.actions.2.name: War Pick
duergar.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.
duergar.actions.3.name: Javelin
duergar.actions.3.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.
duergar.actions.4.name: Invisibility
duergar.actions.4.desc: The duergar magically turns invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the duergar wears or carries is invisible with it.
duergar.name: Duergar
dust-mephit.special.1.name: Death Burst
dust-mephit.special.1.desc: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of dust. Each creature within 5 ft. of it must then succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
dust-mephit.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
dust-mephit.special.2.desc: The mephit can innately cast sleep, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.
dust-mephit.actions.1.name: Claws
dust-mephit.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
dust-mephit.actions.2.name: Blinding Breath
dust-mephit.actions.2.desc: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of blinding dust. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
dust-mephit.name: Dust Mephit
eagle.special.1.name: Keen Sight
eagle.special.1.desc: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
eagle.actions.1.name: Talons
eagle.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
eagle.name: Eagle
earth-elemental.special.1.name: Earth Glide
earth-elemental.special.1.desc: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.
earth-elemental.special.2.name: Siege Monster
earth-elemental.special.2.desc: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.
earth-elemental.actions.1.name: Multiattack
earth-elemental.actions.1.desc: The elemental makes two slam attacks.
earth-elemental.actions.2.name: Slam
earth-elemental.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
earth-elemental.name: Earth Elemental
earth-elemental.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
efreeti.special.1.name: Elemental Demise
efreeti.special.1.desc: If the efreeti dies, its body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying.
efreeti.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
efreeti.special.2.desc:
The efreeti's innate spell casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect magic
3/day: enlarge/reduce, tongues
1/day each: conjure elemental (fire elemental only), gaseous form, invisibility, major image, plane shift, wall of fire
efreeti.actions.1.name: Multiattack
efreeti.actions.1.desc: The efreeti makes two scimitar attacks or uses its Hurl Flame twice.
efreeti.actions.2.name: Scimitar
efreeti.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
efreeti.actions.3.name: Hurl Flame
efreeti.actions.3.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (5d6) fire damage.
efreeti.name: Efreeti
elephant.special.1.name: Trampling Charge
elephant.special.1.desc: If the elephant moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the elephant can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.
elephant.actions.1.name: Gore
elephant.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.
elephant.actions.2.name: Stomp
elephant.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
elephant.name: Elephant
elk.special.1.name: Charge
elk.special.1.desc: If the elk moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
elk.actions.1.name: Ram
elk.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
elk.actions.2.name: Hooves
elk.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
elk.name: Elk
erinyes.special.1.name: Hellish Weapons
erinyes.special.1.desc: The erinyes's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 (3d8) poison damage on a hit (included in the attacks).
erinyes.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
erinyes.special.2.desc: The erinyes has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
erinyes.actions.1.name: Multiattack
erinyes.actions.2.name: Longsword
erinyes.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.
erinyes.actions.3.name: Longbow
erinyes.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. The poison lasts until it is removed by the lesser restoration spell or similar magic.
erinyes.reactions.1.name: Parry
erinyes.reactions.1.desc: The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the erinyes must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
erinyes.name: Erinyes
erinyes.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
ettercap.special.1.name: Spider Climb
ettercap.special.1.desc: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
ettercap.special.2.name: Web Sense
ettercap.special.2.desc: While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
ettercap.special.3.name: Web Walker
ettercap.special.3.desc: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
ettercap.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ettercap.actions.1.desc: The ettercap makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
ettercap.actions.2.name: Bite
ettercap.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
ettercap.actions.3.name: Claws
ettercap.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
ettercap.actions.4.name: Web
ettercap.actions.4.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 11 Strength check, escaping from the webbing on a success. The effect ends if the webbing is destroyed. The webbing has AC 10, 5 hit points, is vulnerable to fire damage and immune to bludgeoning damage.
ettercap.name: Ettercap
ettin.special.1.name: Two Heads
ettin.special.1.desc: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
ettin.special.2.name: Wakeful
ettin.special.2.desc: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.
ettin.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ettin.actions.1.desc: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar.
ettin.actions.2.name: Battleaxe
ettin.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.
ettin.actions.3.name: Morningstar
ettin.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.
ettin.name: Ettin
fire-elemental.special.1.name: Fire Form
fire-elemental.special.1.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
fire-elemental.special.2.name: Illumination
fire-elemental.special.2.desc: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 ft..
fire-elemental.special.3.name: Water Susceptibility
fire-elemental.special.3.desc: For every 5 ft. the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.
fire-elemental.actions.1.name: Multiattack
fire-elemental.actions.1.desc: The elemental makes two touch attacks.
fire-elemental.actions.2.name: Touch
fire-elemental.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
fire-elemental.name: Fire Elemental
fire-elemental.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
fire-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
fire-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two greatsword attacks.
fire-giant.actions.2.name: Greatsword
fire-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing damage.
fire-giant.actions.3.name: Rock
fire-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
fire-giant.name: Fire Giant
flesh-golem.special.1.name: Berserk
flesh-golem.special.1.desc:
Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.
The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 hit points or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.
flesh-golem.special.2.name: Aversion of Fire
flesh-golem.special.2.desc: If the golem takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
flesh-golem.special.3.name: Immutable Form
flesh-golem.special.3.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.
flesh-golem.special.4.name: Lightning Absorption
flesh-golem.special.4.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.
flesh-golem.special.5.name: Magic Resistance
flesh-golem.special.5.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
flesh-golem.special.6.name: Magic Weapons
flesh-golem.special.6.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.
flesh-golem.actions.1.name: Multiattack
flesh-golem.actions.1.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.
flesh-golem.actions.2.name: Slam
flesh-golem.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
flesh-golem.name: Flesh Golem
flesh-golem.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
flesh-golem.immunities: lightning; poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
flying-snake.special.1.name: Flyby
flying-snake.special.1.desc: The snake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
flying-snake.actions.1.name: Bite
flying-snake.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) poison damage.
flying-snake.name: Flying Snake
flying-snake.desc: A flying snake is a brightly colored, winged serpent found in remote jungles. Tribespeople and cultists sometimes domesticate flying snakes to serve as messengers that deliver scrolls wrapped in their coils.
flying-sword.special.1.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
flying-sword.special.1.desc: The sword is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the sword must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.
flying-sword.special.2.name: False Appearance
flying-sword.special.2.desc: While the sword remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.
flying-sword.actions.1.name: Longsword
flying-sword.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.
flying-sword.name: Flying Sword
frog.special.1.name: Amphibious
frog.special.1.desc: The frog can breathe air and water
frog.special.2.name: Standing Leap
frog.special.2.desc: The frog's long jump is up to 10 ft. and its high jump is up to 5 ft., with or without a running start.
frog.name: Frog
frog.desc: A frog has no effective attacks. It feeds on small insects and typically dwells near water, in trees, or underground. The frog’s statistics can also be used to represent a toad.
frost-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
frost-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two greataxe attacks.
frost-giant.actions.2.name: Greataxe
frost-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage.
frost-giant.actions.3.name: Rock
frost-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
frost-giant.name: Frost Giant
gargoyle.special.1.name: False Appearance
gargoyle.special.1.desc: While the gargoyle remains motion less, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.
gargoyle.actions.1.name: Multiattack
gargoyle.actions.1.desc: The gargoyle makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
gargoyle.actions.2.name: Bite
gargoyle.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
gargoyle.actions.3.name: Claws
gargoyle.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
gargoyle.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
gelatinous-cube.special.1.name: Ooze Cube
gelatinous-cube.special.1.desc:
The cube takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw.
Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have total cover.
A creature within 5 feet of the cube can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful DC 12 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.
The cube can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.
gelatinous-cube.special.2.name: Transparent
gelatinous-cube.special.2.desc: Even when the cube is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a cube that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the cube's space while unaware of the cube is surprised by the cube.
gelatinous-cube.actions.1.name: Pseudopod
gelatinous-cube.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.
gelatinous-cube.actions.2.name: Engulf
gelatinous-cube.actions.2.desc:
The cube moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the cube. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.
On a failed save, the cube enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the cube.
gelatinous-cube.name: Gelatinous Cube
ghast.special.1.name: Stench
ghast.special.1.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the ghast must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the ghast's Stench for 24 hours.
ghast.special.2.name: Turn Defiance
ghast.special.2.desc: The ghast and any ghouls within 30 ft. of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.
ghast.actions.1.name: Bite
ghast.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
ghast.actions.2.name: Claws
ghast.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
ghast.name: Ghast
ghost.special.1.name: Ethereal Sight
ghost.special.1.desc: The ghost can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.
ghost.special.2.name: Incorporeal Movement
ghost.special.2.desc: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
ghost.actions.1.name: Withering Touch
ghost.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
ghost.actions.2.name: Etherealness
ghost.actions.2.desc: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.
ghost.actions.3.name: Horrifying Visage
ghost.actions.3.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 ft. of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.
ghost.actions.4.name: Possession
ghost.actions.4.desc:
One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.
ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.languages: any languages it knew in life
ghost.resistances: acid; fire; lightning; thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
ghoul.actions.1.name: Bite
ghoul.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
ghoul.actions.2.name: Claws
ghoul.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
ghoul.name: Ghoul
giant-ape.actions.1.name: Multiattack
giant-ape.actions.1.desc: The ape makes two fist attacks.
giant-ape.actions.2.name: Fist
giant-ape.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
giant-ape.actions.3.name: Rock
giant-ape.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 50/100 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (7d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
giant-ape.name: Giant Ape
giant-badger.special.1.name: Keen Smell
giant-badger.special.1.desc: The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
giant-badger.actions.1.name: Multiattack
giant-badger.actions.1.desc: The badger makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
giant-badger.actions.2.name: Bite
giant-badger.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
giant-badger.actions.3.name: Claws
giant-badger.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.
giant-badger.name: Giant Badger
giant-bat.special.1.name: Echolocation
giant-bat.special.1.desc: The bat can't use its blindsight while deafened.
giant-bat.special.2.name: Keen Hearing
giant-bat.special.2.desc: The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
giant-bat.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-bat.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
giant-bat.name: Giant Bat
giant-boar.special.1.name: Charge
giant-boar.special.1.desc: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
giant-boar.special.2.name: Relentless
giant-boar.special.2.desc: If the boar takes 10 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.
giant-boar.actions.1.name: Tusk
giant-boar.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
giant-boar.name: Giant Boar
giant-centipede.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-centipede.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.
giant-centipede.name: Giant Centipede
giant-constrictor-snake.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-constrictor-snake.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
giant-constrictor-snake.actions.2.name: Constrict
giant-constrictor-snake.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the snake can't constrict another target.
giant-constrictor-snake.name: Giant Constrictor Snake
giant-crab.special.1.name: Amphibious
giant-crab.special.1.desc: The crab can breathe air and water.
giant-crab.actions.1.name: Claw
giant-crab.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.
giant-crab.name: Giant Crab
giant-crocodile.special.1.name: Hold Breath
giant-crocodile.special.1.desc: The crocodile can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
giant-crocodile.actions.1.name: Multiattack
giant-crocodile.actions.1.desc: The crocodile makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.
giant-crocodile.actions.2.name: Bite
giant-crocodile.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can't bite another target.
giant-crocodile.actions.3.name: Tail
giant-crocodile.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the crocodile. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
giant-crocodile.name: Giant Crocodile
giant-eagle.special.1.name: Keen Sight
giant-eagle.special.1.desc: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
giant-eagle.actions.1.name: Multiattack
giant-eagle.actions.1.desc: The eagle makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.
giant-eagle.actions.2.name: Beak
giant-eagle.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
giant-eagle.actions.3.name: Talons
giant-eagle.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
giant-eagle.name: Giant Eagle
giant-eagle.desc: A giant eagle is a noble creature that speaks its own language and understands speech in the Common tongue. A mated pair of giant eagles typically has up to four eggs or young in their nest (treat the young as normal eagles).
giant-eagle.languages: Giant Eagle, understands Common and Auran but can't speak
giant-elk.special.1.name: Charge
giant-elk.special.1.desc: If the elk moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
giant-elk.actions.1.name: Ram
giant-elk.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
giant-elk.actions.2.name: Hooves
giant-elk.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
giant-elk.name: Giant Elk
giant-elk.desc: The majestic giant elk is rare to the point that its appearance is often taken as a foreshadowing of an important event, such as the birth of a king. Legends tell of gods that take the form of giant elk when visiting the Material Plane. Many cultures therefore believe that to hunt these creatures is to invite divine wrath.
giant-elk.languages: Giant Elk, understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak
giant-fire-beetle.special.1.name: Illumination
giant-fire-beetle.special.1.desc: The beetle sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 ft..
giant-fire-beetle.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-fire-beetle.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) slashing damage.
giant-fire-beetle.name: Giant Fire Beetle
giant-fire-beetle.desc: A giant fire beetle is a nocturnal creature that takes its name from a pair of glowing glands that give off light. Miners and adventurers prize these creatures, for a giant fire beetle’s glands continue to shed light for 1d6 days after the beetle dies. Giant fire beetles are most commonly found underground and in dark forests.
giant-frog.special.1.name: Amphibious
giant-frog.special.1.desc: The frog can breathe air and water
giant-frog.special.2.name: Standing Leap
giant-frog.special.2.desc: The frog's long jump is up to 20 ft. and its high jump is up to 10 ft., with or without a running start.
giant-frog.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-frog.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the frog can't bite another target.
giant-frog.actions.2.name: Swallow
giant-frog.actions.2.desc: The frog makes one bite attack against a Small or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 5 (2d4) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. The frog can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 ft. of movement, exiting prone.
giant-frog.name: Giant Frog
giant-goat.special.1.name: Charge
giant-goat.special.1.desc: If the goat moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
giant-goat.special.2.name: Sure-Footed
giant-goat.special.2.desc: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.
giant-goat.actions.1.name: Ram
giant-goat.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
giant-goat.name: Giant Goat
giant-hyena.special.1.name: Rampage
giant-hyena.special.1.desc: When the hyena reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the hyena can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.
giant-hyena.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-hyena.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
giant-hyena.name: Giant Hyena
giant-lizard.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-lizard.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
giant-lizard.name: Giant Lizard
giant-lizard.desc: A giant lizard can be ridden or used as a draft animal. Lizardfolk also keep them as pets, and subterranean giant lizards are used as mounts and pack animals by drow, duergar, and others.
giant-octopus.special.1.name: Hold Breath
giant-octopus.special.1.desc: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.
giant-octopus.special.2.name: Underwater Camouflage
giant-octopus.special.2.desc: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.
giant-octopus.special.3.name: Water Breathing
giant-octopus.special.3.desc: The octopus can breathe only underwater.
giant-octopus.actions.1.name: Tentacles
giant-octopus.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the octopus can't use its tentacles on another target.
giant-octopus.actions.2.name: Ink Cloud
giant-octopus.actions.2.desc: A 20-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the octopus if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action.
giant-octopus.name: Giant Octopus
giant-owl.special.1.name: Flyby
giant-owl.special.1.desc: The owl doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
giant-owl.special.2.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
giant-owl.special.2.desc: The owl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.
giant-owl.actions.1.name: Talons
giant-owl.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage.
giant-owl.name: Giant Owl
giant-owl.languages: Giant Owl, understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak
giant-poisonous-snake.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-poisonous-snake.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
giant-poisonous-snake.name: Giant Poisonous Snake
giant-rat.special.1.name: Keen Smell
giant-rat.special.1.desc: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
giant-rat.special.2.name: Pack Tactics
giant-rat.special.2.desc: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
giant-rat.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-rat.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
giant-rat.name: Giant Rat
giant-rat-diseased.special.1.name: Keen Smell
giant-rat-diseased.special.1.desc: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
giant-rat-diseased.special.2.name: Pack Tactics
giant-rat-diseased.special.2.desc: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
giant-rat-diseased.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-rat-diseased.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hit points except by magical means, and the target's hit point maximum decreases by 3 (1d6) every 24 hours. If the target's hit point maximum drops to 0 as a result of this disease, the target dies.
giant-rat-diseased.name: Giant Rat (Diseased)
giant-scorpion.actions.1.name: Claw
giant-scorpion.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). The scorpion has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.
giant-scorpion.actions.2.name: Multiattack
giant-scorpion.actions.2.desc: The scorpion makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.
giant-scorpion.actions.3.name: Sting
giant-scorpion.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
giant-scorpion.name: Giant Scorpion
giant-sea-horse.special.1.name: Charge
giant-sea-horse.special.1.desc: If the sea horse moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
giant-sea-horse.special.2.name: Water Breathing
giant-sea-horse.special.2.desc: The sea horse can breathe only underwater.
giant-sea-horse.actions.1.name: Ram
giant-sea-horse.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
giant-sea-horse.name: Giant Sea Horse
giant-sea-horse.desc: Like their smaller kin, giant sea horses are shy, colorful fish with elongated bodies and curled tails. Aquatic elves train them as mounts.
giant-shark.special.1.name: Blood Frenzy
giant-shark.special.1.desc: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.
giant-shark.special.2.name: Water Breathing
giant-shark.special.2.desc: The shark can breathe only underwater.
giant-shark.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-shark.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.
giant-shark.name: Giant Shark
giant-shark.desc: A giant shark is 30 feet long and normally found in deep oceans. Utterly fearless, it preys on anything that crosses its path, including whales and ships.
giant-spider.special.1.name: Spider Climb
giant-spider.special.1.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
giant-spider.special.2.name: Web Sense
giant-spider.special.2.desc: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
giant-spider.special.3.name: Web Walker
giant-spider.special.3.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
giant-spider.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-spider.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.
giant-spider.actions.2.name: Web
giant-spider.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).
giant-spider.name: Giant Spider
giant-spider.desc: To snare its prey, a giant spider spins elaborate webs or shoots sticky strands of webbing from its abdomen. Giant spiders are most commonly found underground, making their lairs on ceilings or in dark, web-filled crevices. Such lairs are often festooned with web cocoons holding past victims.
giant-toad.special.1.name: Amphibious
giant-toad.special.1.desc: The toad can breathe air and water
giant-toad.special.2.name: Standing Leap
giant-toad.special.2.desc: The toad's long jump is up to 20 ft. and its high jump is up to 10 ft., with or without a running start.
giant-toad.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-toad.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the toad can't bite another target.
giant-toad.actions.2.name: Swallow
giant-toad.actions.2.desc:
The toad makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.
giant-toad.name: Giant Toad
giant-vulture.special.1.name: Keen Sight and Smell
giant-vulture.special.1.desc: The vulture has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.
giant-vulture.special.2.name: Pack Tactics
giant-vulture.special.2.desc: The vulture has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
giant-vulture.actions.1.name: Multiattack
giant-vulture.actions.1.desc: The vulture makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.
giant-vulture.actions.2.name: Beak
giant-vulture.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.
giant-vulture.actions.3.name: Talons
giant-vulture.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.
giant-vulture.name: Giant Vulture
giant-vulture.desc: A giant vulture has advanced intelligence and a malevolent bent. Unlike its smaller kin, it will attack a wounded creature to hasten its end. Giant vultures have been known to haunt a thirsty, starving creature for days to enjoy its suffering.
giant-wasp.actions.1.name: Sting
giant-wasp.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.
giant-wasp.name: Giant Wasp
giant-weasel.special.1.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
giant-weasel.special.1.desc: The weasel has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
giant-weasel.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-weasel.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
giant-weasel.name: Giant Weasel
giant-wolf-spider.special.1.name: Spider Climb
giant-wolf-spider.special.1.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
giant-wolf-spider.special.2.name: Web Sense
giant-wolf-spider.special.2.desc: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
giant-wolf-spider.special.3.name: Web Walker
giant-wolf-spider.special.3.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
giant-wolf-spider.actions.1.name: Bite
giant-wolf-spider.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.
giant-wolf-spider.name: Giant Wolf Spider
giant-wolf-spider.desc: Smaller than a giant spider, a giant wolf spider hunts prey across open ground or hides in a burrow or crevice, or in a hidden cavity beneath debris.
gibbering-mouther.special.1.name: Aberrant Ground
gibbering-mouther.special.1.desc: The ground in a 10-foot radius around the mouther is doughlike difficult terrain. Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.
gibbering-mouther.special.2.name: Gibbering
gibbering-mouther.special.2.desc: The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't incapacitated. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther and can hear the gibbering must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a d8 to determine what it does during its turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.
gibbering-mouther.actions.1.name: Multiattack
gibbering-mouther.actions.1.desc: The gibbering mouther makes one bite attack and, if it can, uses its Blinding Spittle.
gibbering-mouther.actions.2.name: Bites
gibbering-mouther.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (5d6) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is killed by this damage, it is absorbed into the mouther.
gibbering-mouther.actions.3.name: Blinding Spittle
gibbering-mouther.actions.3.desc: The mouther spits a chemical glob at a point it can see within 15 feet of it. The glob explodes in a blinding flash of light on impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the flash must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mouther's next turn.
gibbering-mouther.name: Gibbering Mouther
glabrezu.special.1.name: Innate Spellcasting
glabrezu.special.1.desc:
The glabrezu's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16). The glabrezu can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: darkness, detect magic, dispel magic
1/day each: confusion, fly, power word stun
glabrezu.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
glabrezu.special.2.desc: The glabrezu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
glabrezu.actions.1.name: Multiattack
glabrezu.actions.1.desc: The glabrezu makes four attacks: two with its pincers and two with its fists. Alternatively, it makes two attacks with its pincers and casts one spell.
glabrezu.actions.2.name: Pincer
glabrezu.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). The glabrezu has two pincers, each of which can grapple only one target.
glabrezu.actions.3.name: Fist
glabrezu.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
glabrezu.name: Glabrezu
glabrezu.resistances: cold; fire; lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
gladiator.special.1.name: Brave
gladiator.special.1.desc: The gladiator has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
gladiator.special.2.name: Brute
gladiator.special.2.desc: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the gladiator hits with it (included in the attack).
gladiator.actions.1.name: Multiattack
gladiator.actions.1.desc: The gladiator makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.
gladiator.actions.2.name: Spear
gladiator.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
gladiator.actions.3.name: Shield Bash
gladiator.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
gladiator.reactions.1.name: Parry
gladiator.reactions.1.desc: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the gladiator must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
gladiator.name: Gladiator
gladiator.desc: Gladiators battle for the entertainment of raucous crowds. Some gladiators are brutal pit fighters who treat each match as a life-or-death struggle, while others are professional duelists who command huge fees but rarely fight to the death.
gnoll.special.1.name: Rampage
gnoll.special.1.desc: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.
gnoll.actions.1.name: Bite
gnoll.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
gnoll.actions.2.name: Spear
gnoll.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
gnoll.actions.3.name: Longbow
gnoll.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
gnoll.name: Gnoll
goat.special.1.name: Charge
goat.special.1.desc: If the goat moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
goat.special.2.name: Sure-Footed
goat.special.2.desc: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.
goat.actions.1.name: Ram
goat.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
goat.name: Goat
goblin.special.1.name: Nimble Escape
goblin.special.1.desc: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
goblin.actions.1.name: Scimitar
goblin.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
goblin.actions.2.name: Shortbow
goblin.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
goblin.name: Goblin
gold-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.name: Amphibious
gold-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Bite
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Breath Weapons
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Fire Breath. The dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Weakening Breath. The dragon exhales gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
gold-dragon-wyrmling.name: Gold Dragon Wyrmling
gorgon.special.1.name: Trampling Charge
gorgon.special.1.desc: If the gorgon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the gorgon can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.
gorgon.actions.1.name: Gore
gorgon.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.
gorgon.actions.2.name: Hooves
gorgon.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
gorgon.actions.3.name: Petrifying Breath
gorgon.actions.3.desc: The gorgon exhales petrifying gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.
gorgon.name: Gorgon
gray-ooze.special.1.name: Amorphous
gray-ooze.special.1.desc: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
gray-ooze.special.2.name: Corrode Metal
gray-ooze.special.2.desc:
Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the ooze corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the ooze is destroyed after dealing damage.
The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal in 1 round.
gray-ooze.special.3.name: False Appearance
gray-ooze.special.3.desc: While the ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oily pool or wet rock.
gray-ooze.actions.1.name: Pseudopod
gray-ooze.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage, and if the target is wearing nonmagical metal armor, its armor is partly corroded and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.
gray-ooze.name: Gray Ooze
green-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.name: Amphibious
green-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
green-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Bite
green-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
green-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Poison Breath
green-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc: The dragon exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
green-dragon-wyrmling.name: Green Dragon Wyrmling
green-hag.special.1.name: Amphibious
green-hag.special.1.desc: The hag can breathe air and water.
green-hag.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
green-hag.special.2.desc:
The hag's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: dancing lights, minor illusion, vicious mockery
green-hag.special.3.name: Mimicry
green-hag.special.3.desc: The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
green-hag.actions.1.name: Claws
green-hag.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
green-hag.actions.2.name: Illusory Appearance
green-hag.actions.2.desc:
The hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.
The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the hag could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching her would feel her rough flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the hag is disguised.
green-hag.actions.3.name: Invisible Passage
green-hag.actions.3.desc: The hag magically turns invisible until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). While invisible, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, so she can be tracked only by magic. Any equipment she wears or carries is invisible with her.
green-hag.name: Green Hag
grick.special.1.name: Stone Camouflage
grick.special.1.desc: The grick has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.
grick.actions.1.name: Multiattack
grick.actions.1.desc: The grick makes one attack with its tentacles. If that attack hits, the grick can make one beak attack against the same target.
grick.actions.2.name: Tentacles
grick.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.
grick.actions.3.name: Beak
grick.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
grick.name: Grick
grick.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
griffon.special.1.name: Keen Sight
griffon.special.1.desc: The griffon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
griffon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
griffon.actions.1.desc: The griffon makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.
griffon.actions.2.name: Beak
griffon.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
griffon.actions.3.name: Claws
griffon.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
griffon.name: Griffon
grimlock.special.1.name: Blind Senses
grimlock.special.1.desc: The grimlock can't use its blindsight while deafened and unable to smell.
grimlock.special.2.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
grimlock.special.2.desc: The grimlock has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
grimlock.special.3.name: Stone Camouflage
grimlock.special.3.desc: The grimlock has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.
grimlock.actions.1.name: Spiked Bone Club
grimlock.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
grimlock.name: Grimlock
guard.actions.1.name: Spear
guard.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
guard.name: Guard
guard.desc: Guards include members of a city watch, sentries in a citadel or fortified town, and the bodyguards of merchants and nobles.
guardian-naga.special.1.name: Rejuvenation
guardian-naga.special.1.desc: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.
guardian-naga.special.2.name: Spellcasting
guardian-naga.special.2.desc:
The naga is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks), and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells. It has the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): mending, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (4 slots): command, cure wounds, shield of faith
- 2nd level (3 slots): calm emotions, hold person
- 3rd level (3 slots): bestow curse, clairvoyance
- 4th level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement
- 5th level (2 slots): flame strike, geas
- 6th level (1 slot): true seeing
guardian-naga.actions.1.name: Bite
guardian-naga.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
guardian-naga.actions.2.name: Spit Poison
guardian-naga.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one creature. Hit: The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
guardian-naga.name: Guardian Naga
gynosphinx.special.1.name: Inscrutable
gynosphinx.special.1.desc: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
gynosphinx.special.2.name: Magic Weapons
gynosphinx.special.2.desc: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.
gynosphinx.special.3.name: Spellcasting
gynosphinx.special.3.desc:
The sphinx is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no material components to cast its spells. The sphinx has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation
- 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, identify, shield
- 2nd level (3 slots): darkness, locate object, suggestion
- 3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, remove curse, tongues
- 4th level (3 slots): banishment, greater invisibility
- 5th level (1 slot): legend lore
gynosphinx.actions.1.name: Multiattack
gynosphinx.actions.1.desc: The sphinx makes two claw attacks.
gynosphinx.actions.2.name: Claw
gynosphinx.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
gynosphinx.legendary.1.name: Claw Attack
gynosphinx.legendary.1.desc: The sphinx makes one claw attack.
gynosphinx.legendary.2.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
gynosphinx.legendary.2.desc: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
gynosphinx.legendary.3.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
gynosphinx.legendary.3.desc: The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.
gynosphinx.name: Gynosphinx
gynosphinx.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.1.name: Multiattack
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.1.desc: The veteran makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.2.name: Longsword
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.3.name: Shortsword
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.4.name: Heavy Crossbow
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.4.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.5.name: Fire Breath
half-red-dragon-veteran.actions.5.desc: The veteran exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
half-red-dragon-veteran.name: Half-Red Dragon Veteran
harpy.actions.1.name: Multiattack
harpy.actions.1.desc: The harpy makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its club.
harpy.actions.2.name: Claws
harpy.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.
harpy.actions.3.name: Club
harpy.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
harpy.actions.4.name: Luring Song
harpy.actions.4.desc:
The harpy sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 ft. of the harpy that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The harpy must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the harpy is incapacitated.
While charmed by the harpy, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 ft. away from the harpy, the must move on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, a target can repeat the saving throw. A creature can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this harpy's song for the next 24 hours.
harpy.name: Harpy
hawk.special.1.name: Keen Sight
hawk.special.1.desc: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
hawk.actions.1.name: Talons
hawk.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.
hawk.name: Hawk
hell-hound.special.1.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
hell-hound.special.1.desc: The hound has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
hell-hound.special.2.name: Pack Tactics
hell-hound.special.2.desc: The hound has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
hell-hound.actions.1.name: Bite
hell-hound.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
hell-hound.actions.2.name: Fire Breath
hell-hound.actions.2.desc: The hound exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
hell-hound.name: Hell Hound
hell-hound.languages: understands Infernal but can't speak it
hezrou.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
hezrou.special.1.desc: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
hezrou.special.2.name: Stench
hezrou.special.2.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezrou's stench for 24 hours.
hezrou.actions.1.name: Multiattack
hezrou.actions.1.desc: The hezrou makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
hezrou.actions.2.name: Bite
hezrou.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
hezrou.actions.3.name: Claws
hezrou.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
hezrou.name: Hezrou
hezrou.resistances: cold; fire; lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
hill-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
hill-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.
hill-giant.actions.2.name: Greatclub
hill-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
hill-giant.actions.3.name: Rock
hill-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
hill-giant.name: Hill Giant
hippogriff.special.1.name: Keen Sight
hippogriff.special.1.desc: The hippogriff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
hippogriff.actions.1.name: Multiattack
hippogriff.actions.1.desc: The hippogriff makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.
hippogriff.actions.2.name: Beak
hippogriff.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
hippogriff.actions.3.name: Claws
hippogriff.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
hippogriff.name: Hippogriff
hobgoblin.special.1.name: Martial Advantage
hobgoblin.special.1.desc: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 ft. of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.
hobgoblin.actions.1.name: Longsword
hobgoblin.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.
hobgoblin.actions.2.name: Longbow
hobgoblin.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
homunculus.special.1.name: Telepathic Bond
homunculus.special.1.desc: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.
homunculus.actions.1.name: Bite
homunculus.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.
homunculus.name: Homunculus
homunculus.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
horned-devil.special.1.name: Devil's Sight
horned-devil.special.1.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.
horned-devil.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
horned-devil.special.2.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
horned-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
horned-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes three melee attacks: two with its fork and one with its tail. It can use Hurl Flame in place of any melee attack.
horned-devil.actions.2.name: Fork
horned-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.
horned-devil.actions.3.name: Tail
horned-devil.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose 10 (3d6) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time the devil hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 10 (3d6). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.
horned-devil.actions.4.name: Hurl Flame
horned-devil.actions.4.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.
horned-devil.name: Horned Devil
horned-devil.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
hunter-shark.special.1.name: Blood Frenzy
hunter-shark.special.1.desc: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.
hunter-shark.special.2.name: Water Breathing
hunter-shark.special.2.desc: The shark can breathe only underwater.
hunter-shark.actions.1.name: Bite
hunter-shark.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
hunter-shark.name: Hunter Shark
hunter-shark.desc: Smaller than a giant shark but larger and fiercer than a reef shark, a hunter shark haunts deep waters. It usually hunts alone, but multiple hunter sharks might feed in the same area. A fully grown hunter shark is 15 to 20 feet long.
hydra.special.1.name: Hold Breath
hydra.special.1.desc: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.
hydra.special.2.name: Multiple Heads
hydra.special.2.desc:
The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies.
At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.
hydra.special.3.name: Reactive Heads
hydra.special.3.desc: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.
hydra.special.4.name: Wakeful
hydra.special.4.desc: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.
hydra.actions.1.name: Multiattack
hydra.actions.1.desc: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.
hydra.actions.2.name: Bite
hydra.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.
hydra.name: Hydra
hyena.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
hyena.special.1.desc: The hyena has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hyena's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
hyena.actions.1.name: Bite
hyena.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.
hyena.name: Hyena
ice-devil.special.1.name: Devil's Sight
ice-devil.special.1.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.
ice-devil.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
ice-devil.special.2.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
ice-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ice-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.
ice-devil.actions.2.name: Bite
ice-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.
ice-devil.actions.3.name: Claws
ice-devil.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.
ice-devil.actions.4.name: Tail
