ice-devil.actions.4.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.
ice-devil.actions.5.name: Wall of Ice
ice-devil.actions.5.desc:
The devil magically forms an opaque wall of ice on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall is 1 foot thick and up to 30 feet long and 10 feet high, or it's a hemispherical dome up to 20 feet in diameter.
When the wall appears, each creature in its space is pushed out of it by the shortest route. The creature chooses which side of the wall to end up on, unless the creature is incapacitated. The creature then makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the devil is incapacitated or dies. The wall can be damaged and breached; each 10-foot section has AC 5, 30 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. If a section is destroyed, it leaves behind a sheet of frigid air in the space the wall occupied. Whenever a creature finishes moving through the frigid air on a turn, willingly or otherwise, the creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The frigid air dissipates when the rest of the wall vanishes.
ice-devil.name: Ice Devil
ice-devil.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
ice-mephit.special.1.name: Death Burst
ice-mephit.special.1.desc: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of jagged ice. Each creature within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
ice-mephit.special.2.name: False Appearance
ice-mephit.special.2.desc: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary shard of ice.
ice-mephit.special.3.name: Innate Spellcasting
ice-mephit.special.3.desc: The mephit can innately cast fog cloud, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.
ice-mephit.actions.1.name: Claws
ice-mephit.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.
ice-mephit.actions.2.name: Frost Breath
ice-mephit.actions.2.desc: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of cold air. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
ice-mephit.name: Ice Mephit
imp.special.1.name: Shapechanger
imp.special.1.desc: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., climb 20 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
imp.special.2.name: Devil's Sight
imp.special.2.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's darkvision.
imp.special.3.name: Magic Resistance
imp.special.3.desc: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
imp.actions.1.name: Sting (Bite in Beast Form)
imp.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
imp.actions.2.name: Invisibility
imp.actions.2.desc: The imp magically turns invisible until it attacks, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is invisible with it.
imp.name: Imp
imp.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
invisible-stalker.special.1.name: Invisibility
invisible-stalker.special.2.name: Faultless Tracker
invisible-stalker.special.2.desc: The stalker is given a quarry by its summoner. The stalker knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence. The stalker also knows the location of its summoner.
invisible-stalker.actions.1.name: Multiattack
invisible-stalker.actions.1.desc: The stalker makes two slam attacks.
invisible-stalker.actions.2.name: Slam
invisible-stalker.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
invisible-stalker.name: Invisible Stalker
invisible-stalker.languages: Auran, understands Common but doesn't speak it
invisible-stalker.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
iron-golem.special.1.name: Fire Absorption
iron-golem.special.1.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.
iron-golem.special.2.name: Immutable Form
iron-golem.special.2.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.
iron-golem.special.3.name: Magic Resistance
iron-golem.special.3.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
iron-golem.special.4.name: Magic Weapons
iron-golem.special.4.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.
iron-golem.actions.1.name: Multiattack
iron-golem.actions.1.desc: The golem makes two melee attacks.
iron-golem.actions.2.name: Slam
iron-golem.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
iron-golem.actions.3.name: Sword
iron-golem.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage.
iron-golem.actions.4.name: Poison Breath
iron-golem.actions.4.desc: The golem exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
iron-golem.name: Iron Golem
iron-golem.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
iron-golem.immunities: fire; poison; psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
jackal.special.1.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
jackal.special.1.desc: The jackal has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
jackal.special.2.name: Pack Tactics
jackal.special.2.desc: The jackal has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackal's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
jackal.actions.1.name: Bite
jackal.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.
jackal.name: Jackal
killer-whale.special.1.name: Echolocation
killer-whale.special.1.desc: The whale can't use its blindsight while deafened.
killer-whale.special.2.name: Hold Breath
killer-whale.special.2.desc: The whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes
killer-whale.special.3.name: Keen Hearing
killer-whale.special.3.desc: The whale has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
killer-whale.actions.1.name: Bite
killer-whale.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage.
killer-whale.name: Killer Whale
knight.special.1.name: Brave
knight.special.1.desc: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
knight.actions.1.name: Multiattack
knight.actions.1.desc: The knight makes two melee attacks.
knight.actions.2.name: Greatsword
knight.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
knight.actions.3.name: Heavy Crossbow
knight.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.
knight.actions.4.name: Leadership
knight.actions.4.desc: For 1 minute, the knight can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 ft. of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the knight. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the knight is incapacitated.
knight.reactions.1.name: Parry
knight.reactions.1.desc: The knight adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the knight must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
knight.name: Knight
knight.desc: Knights are warriors who pledge service to rulers, religious orders, and noble causes. A knight’s alignment determines the extent to which a pledge is honored. Whether undertaking a quest or patrolling a realm, a knight often travels with an entourage that includes squires and hirelings who are commoners.
kobold.special.1.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
kobold.special.1.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
kobold.special.2.name: Pack Tactics
kobold.special.2.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
kobold.actions.1.name: Dagger
kobold.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
kobold.actions.2.name: Sling
kobold.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
kobold.name: Kobold
kraken.special.1.name: Amphibious
kraken.special.1.desc: The kraken can breathe air and water.
kraken.special.2.name: Freedom of Movement
kraken.special.2.desc: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.
kraken.special.3.name: Siege Monster
kraken.special.3.desc: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.
kraken.actions.1.name: Multiattack
kraken.actions.1.desc: The kraken makes three tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with one use of Fling.
kraken.actions.2.name: Bite
kraken.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the kraken. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.
kraken.actions.3.name: Tentacle
kraken.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.
kraken.actions.4.name: Fling
kraken.actions.4.desc: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.
kraken.actions.5.name: Lightning Storm
kraken.actions.5.desc: The kraken magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target the kraken can see within 120 feet of it. A target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
kraken.legendary.1.name: Tentacle Attack or Fling
kraken.legendary.1.desc: The kraken makes one tentacle attack or uses its Fling.
kraken.legendary.2.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
kraken.legendary.3.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
kraken.legendary.3.desc: While underwater, the kraken expels an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than the kraken. Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken's next turn.
kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.languages: understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.
kraken.immunities: lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
lamia.special.1.name: Innate Spellcasting
lamia.special.1.desc: The lamia's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components. At will: disguise self (any humanoid form), major image 3/day each: charm person, mirror image, scrying, suggestion 1/day: geas
lamia.actions.1.name: Multiattack
lamia.actions.1.desc: The lamia makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its dagger or Intoxicating Touch.
lamia.actions.2.name: Claws
lamia.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.
lamia.actions.3.name: Dagger
lamia.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
lamia.actions.4.name: Intoxicating Touch
lamia.actions.4.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is magically cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all ability checks.
lamia.name: Lamia
lemure.special.1.name: Devil's Sight
lemure.special.1.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the lemure's darkvision.
lemure.special.2.name: Hellish Rejuvenation
lemure.special.2.desc: A lemure that dies in the Nine Hells comes back to life with all its hit points in 1d10 days unless it is killed by a good-aligned creature with a bless spell cast on that creature or its remains are sprinkled with holy water.
lemure.actions.1.name: Fist
lemure.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.
lemure.name: Lemure
lich.special.1.name: Legendary Resistance
lich.special.1.desc: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
lich.special.2.name: Rejuvenation
lich.special.2.desc: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.
lich.special.3.name: Spellcasting
lich.special.3.desc:
The lich is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). The lich has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost
- 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, magic missile, shield, thunderwave
- 2nd level (3 slots): acid arrow, detect thoughts, invisibility, mirror image
- 3rd level (3 slots): animate dead, counterspell, dispel magic, fireball
- 4th level (3 slots): blight, dimension door
- 5th level (3 slots): cloudkill, scrying
- 6th level (1 slot): disintegrate, globe of invulnerability
- 7th level (1 slot): finger of death, plane shift
- 8th level (1 slot): dominate monster, power word stun
- 9th level (1 slot): power word kill
lich.special.4.name: Turn Resistance
lich.special.4.desc: The lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.
lich.actions.1.name: Paralyzing Touch
lich.actions.1.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
lich.legendary.1.name: Cantrip
lich.legendary.2.name: Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
lich.legendary.2.desc: The lich uses its Paralyzing Touch.
lich.legendary.3.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
lich.legendary.3.desc: The lich fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the lich's gaze for the next 24 hours.
lich.legendary.4.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
lich.legendary.4.desc: Each living creature within 20 feet of the lich must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
lich.name: Lich
lich.languages: Common plus up to five other languages
lich.immunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
lion.special.1.name: Keen Smell
lion.special.1.desc: The lion has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
lion.special.2.name: Pack Tactics
lion.special.2.desc: The lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
lion.special.3.name: Pounce
lion.special.3.desc: If the lion moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the lion can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
lion.special.4.name: Running Leap
lion.special.4.desc: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can long jump up to 25 ft..
lion.actions.1.name: Bite
lion.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
lion.actions.2.name: Claw
lion.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
lion.name: Lion
lizard.actions.1.name: Bite
lizard.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
lizard.name: Lizard
lizardfolk.special.1.name: Hold Breath
lizardfolk.special.1.desc: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
lizardfolk.actions.1.name: Multiattack
lizardfolk.actions.1.desc: The lizardfolk makes two melee attacks, each one with a different weapon.
lizardfolk.actions.2.name: Bite
lizardfolk.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
lizardfolk.actions.3.name: Heavy Club
lizardfolk.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
lizardfolk.actions.4.name: Javelin
lizardfolk.actions.4.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
lizardfolk.actions.5.name: Spiked Shield
lizardfolk.actions.5.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
lizardfolk.name: Lizardfolk
mage.special.1.name: Spellcasting
mage.special.1.desc:
The mage is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The mage has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
- 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield
- 2nd level (3 slots): misty step, suggestion
- 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, fly
- 4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility, ice storm
- 5th level (1 slot): cone of cold
mage.actions.1.name: Dagger
mage.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
mage.name: Mage
mage.desc: Mages spend their lives in the study and practice of magic. Good-aligned mages offer counsel to nobles and others in power, while evil mages dwell in isolated sites to perform unspeakable experiments without interference.
magma-mephit.special.1.name: Death Burst
magma-mephit.special.1.desc: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of lava. Each creature within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
magma-mephit.special.2.name: False Appearance
magma-mephit.special.2.desc: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary mound of magma.
magma-mephit.special.3.name: Innate Spellcasting
magma-mephit.special.3.desc: The mephit can innately cast heat metal (spell save DC 10), requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.
magma-mephit.actions.1.name: Claws
magma-mephit.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.
magma-mephit.actions.2.name: Fire Breath
magma-mephit.actions.2.desc: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
magma-mephit.name: Magma Mephit
magmin.special.1.name: Death Burst
magmin.special.1.desc: When the magmin dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature within 10 ft. of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried in that area are ignited.
magmin.special.2.name: Ignited Illumination
magmin.special.2.desc: As a bonus action, the magmin can set itself ablaze or extinguish its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 ft.
magmin.actions.1.name: Touch
magmin.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a target takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.
magmin.name: Magmin
magmin.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
mammoth.special.1.name: Trampling Charge
mammoth.special.1.desc: If the mammoth moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the mammoth can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.
mammoth.actions.1.name: Gore
mammoth.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.
mammoth.actions.2.name: Stomp
mammoth.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
mammoth.name: Mammoth
mammoth.desc: A mammoth is an elephantine creature with thick fur and long tusks. Stockier and fiercer than normal elephants, mammoths inhabit a wide range of climes, from subarctic to subtropical.
manticore.special.1.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
manticore.special.1.desc: The manticore has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when the manticore finishes a long rest.
manticore.actions.1.name: Multiattack
manticore.actions.1.desc: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or three with its tail spikes.
manticore.actions.2.name: Bite
manticore.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
manticore.actions.3.name: Claw
manticore.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
manticore.actions.4.name: Tail Spike
manticore.actions.4.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
manticore.name: Manticore
marilith.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
marilith.special.1.desc: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
marilith.special.2.name: Magic Weapons
marilith.special.2.desc: The marilith's weapon attacks are magical.
marilith.special.3.name: Reactive
marilith.special.3.desc: The marilith can take one reaction on every turn in combat.
marilith.actions.1.name: Multiattack
marilith.actions.1.desc: The marilith can make seven attacks: six with its longswords and one with its tail.
marilith.actions.2.name: Longsword
marilith.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
marilith.actions.3.name: Tail
marilith.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the marilith can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the marilith can't make tail attacks against other targets.
marilith.actions.4.name: Teleport
marilith.actions.4.desc: The marilith magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
marilith.reactions.1.name: Parry
marilith.reactions.1.desc: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the marilith must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
marilith.name: Marilith
marilith.resistances: cold; fire; lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
mastiff.special.1.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
mastiff.special.1.desc: The mastiff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
mastiff.actions.1.name: Bite
mastiff.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
mastiff.name: Mastiff
mastiff.desc: Mastiffs are impressive hounds prized by humanoids for their loyalty and keen senses. Mastiffs can be trained as guard dogs, hunting dogs, and war dogs. Halflings and other Small humanoids ride them as mounts.
medusa.special.1.name: Petrifying Gaze
medusa.special.1.desc:
When a creature that can see the medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 ft. of the medusa, the medusa can force it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw if the medusa isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the medusa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 ft. of it and in an area of bright light, the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.
medusa.actions.1.name: Multiattack
medusa.actions.1.desc: The medusa makes either three melee attacks--one with its snake hair and two with its shortsword--or two ranged attacks with its longbow.
medusa.actions.2.name: Snake Hair
medusa.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
medusa.actions.3.name: Shortsword
medusa.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
medusa.actions.4.name: Longbow
medusa.actions.4.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
medusa.name: Medusa
merfolk.special.1.name: Amphibious
merfolk.special.1.desc: The merfolk can breathe air and water.
merfolk.actions.1.name: Spear
merfolk.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
merfolk.name: Merfolk
merrow.special.1.name: Amphibious
merrow.special.1.desc: The merrow can breathe air and water.
merrow.actions.1.name: Multiattack
merrow.actions.1.desc: The merrow makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or harpoon.
merrow.actions.2.name: Bite
merrow.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
merrow.actions.3.name: Claws
merrow.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.
merrow.actions.4.name: Harpoon
merrow.actions.4.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a Strength contest against the merrow or be pulled up to 20 feet toward the merrow.
merrow.name: Merrow
mimic.special.1.name: Shapechanger
mimic.special.1.desc: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn 't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
mimic.special.2.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
mimic.special.2.desc: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.
mimic.special.3.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
mimic.special.3.desc: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.
mimic.special.4.name: Grappler
mimic.special.4.desc: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.
mimic.actions.1.name: Pseudopod
mimic.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.
mimic.actions.2.name: Bite
mimic.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.
mimic.name: Mimic
minotaur.special.1.name: Charge
minotaur.special.1.desc: If the minotaur moves at least 10 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.
minotaur.special.2.name: Labyrinthine Recall
minotaur.special.2.desc: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.
minotaur.special.3.name: Reckless
minotaur.special.3.desc: At the start of its turn, the minotaur can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
minotaur.actions.1.name: Greataxe
minotaur.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.
minotaur.actions.2.name: Gore
minotaur.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur-skeleton.special.1.name: Charge
minotaur-skeleton.special.1.desc: If the skeleton moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.
minotaur-skeleton.actions.1.name: Greataxe
minotaur-skeleton.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.
minotaur-skeleton.actions.2.name: Gore
minotaur-skeleton.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
minotaur-skeleton.name: Minotaur Skeleton
mule.special.1.name: Beast of Burden
mule.special.1.desc: The mule is considered to be a Large animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.
mule.special.2.name: Sure-Footed
mule.special.2.desc: The mule has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.
mule.actions.1.name: Hooves
mule.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
mule.name: Mule
mummy.actions.1.name: Multiattack
mummy.actions.1.desc: The mummy can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.
mummy.actions.2.name: Rotting Fist
mummy.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.
mummy.actions.3.name: Dreadful Glare
mummy.actions.3.desc: The mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 ft. of it. If the target can see the mummy, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies (but not mummy lords) for the next 24 hours.
mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.languages: the languages it knew in life
mummy.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
mummy-lord.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
mummy-lord.special.1.desc: The mummy lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
mummy-lord.special.2.name: Rejuvenation
mummy-lord.special.2.desc: A destroyed mummy lord gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the mummy lord's heart.
mummy-lord.special.3.name: Spellcasting
mummy-lord.special.3.desc:
The mummy lord is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The mummy lord has the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (4 slots): command, guiding bolt, shield of faith
- 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, silence, spiritual weapon
- 3rd level (3 slots): animate dead, dispel magic
- 4th level (3 slots): divination, guardian of faith
- 5th level (2 slots): contagion, insect plague
- 6th level (1 slot): harm
mummy-lord.actions.1.name: Multiattack
mummy-lord.actions.1.desc: The mummy can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.
mummy-lord.actions.2.name: Rotting Fist
mummy-lord.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.
mummy-lord.actions.3.name: Dreadful Glare
mummy-lord.actions.3.desc: The mummy lord targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy lord, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies and mummy lords for the next 24 hours.
mummy-lord.legendary.1.name: Attack
mummy-lord.legendary.1.desc: The mummy lord makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.
mummy-lord.legendary.2.name: Blinding Dust
mummy-lord.legendary.2.desc: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the mummy lord. Each creature within 5 feet of the mummy lord must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.
mummy-lord.legendary.3.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
mummy-lord.legendary.3.desc: The mummy lord utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.
mummy-lord.legendary.4.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
mummy-lord.legendary.4.desc: The mummy lord magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the mummy lord, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.
mummy-lord.legendary.5.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)
mummy-lord.legendary.5.desc: The mummy lord magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the mummy lord is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the mummy lord remain in its possession.
mummy-lord.name: Mummy Lord
mummy-lord.languages: the languages it knew in life
mummy-lord.immunities: necrotic; poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
nalfeshnee.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
nalfeshnee.special.1.desc: The nalfeshnee has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
nalfeshnee.actions.1.name: Multiattack
nalfeshnee.actions.1.desc: The nalfeshnee uses Horror Nimbus if it can. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
nalfeshnee.actions.2.name: Bite
nalfeshnee.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage.
nalfeshnee.actions.3.name: Claw
nalfeshnee.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.
nalfeshnee.actions.4.name: Horror Nimbus
nalfeshnee.actions.4.desc: The nalfeshnee magically emits scintillating, multicolored light. Each creature within 15 feet of the nalfeshnee that can see the light must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for the next 24 hours.
nalfeshnee.actions.5.name: Teleport
nalfeshnee.actions.5.desc: The nalfeshnee magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
nalfeshnee.name: Nalfeshnee
nalfeshnee.resistances: cold; fire; lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
night-hag.special.1.name: Innate Spellcasting
night-hag.special.1.desc:
The hag's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect magic, magic missile
2/day each: plane shift (self only), ray of enfeeblement, sleep
night-hag.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
night-hag.special.2.desc: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
night-hag.special.3.name: Night Hag Items
night-hag.special.3.desc:
A night hag carries two very rare magic items that she must craft for herself If either object is lost, the night hag will go to great lengths to retrieve it, as creating a new tool takes time and effort.
Heartstone: This lustrous black gem allows a night hag to become ethereal while it is in her possession. The touch of a heartstone also cures any disease. Crafting a heartstone takes 30 days.
Soul Bag: When an evil humanoid dies as a result of a night hag's Nightmare Haunting, the hag catches the soul in this black sack made of stitched flesh. A soul bag can hold only one evil soul at a time, and only the night hag who crafted the bag can catch a soul with it. Crafting a soul bag takes 7 days and a humanoid sacrifice (whose flesh is used to make the bag).
night-hag.actions.1.name: Claws (Hag Form Only)
night-hag.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
night-hag.actions.2.name: Change Shape
night-hag.actions.2.desc: The hag magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium female humanoid, or back into her true form. Her statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. She reverts to her true form if she dies.
night-hag.actions.3.name: Etherealness
night-hag.actions.3.desc: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. To do so, the hag must have a heartstone in her possession.
night-hag.actions.4.name: Nightmare Haunting
night-hag.actions.4.desc: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane. A protection from evil and good spell cast on the target prevents this contact, as does a magic circle. As long as the contact persists, the target has dreadful visions. If these visions last for at least 1 hour, the target gains no benefit from its rest, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). If this effect reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and if the target was evil, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag. The reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or similar magic.
night-hag.name: Night Hag
night-hag.resistances: cold; fire; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
nightmare.special.1.name: Confer Fire Resistance
nightmare.special.1.desc: The nightmare can grant resistance to fire damage to anyone riding it.
nightmare.special.2.name: Illumination
nightmare.special.2.desc: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.
nightmare.actions.1.name: Hooves
nightmare.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
nightmare.actions.2.name: Ethereal Stride
nightmare.actions.2.desc: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it magically enter the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.
nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.languages: understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can't speak
noble.actions.1.name: Rapier
noble.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
noble.reactions.1.name: Parry
noble.reactions.1.desc: The noble adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the noble must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
noble.name: Noble
noble.desc:
**Nobles** wield great authority and influence as members of the upper class, possessing wealth and connections that can make them as powerful as monarchs and generals. A noble often travels in the company of guards, as well as servants who are commoners.

The noble’s statistics can also be used to represent **courtiers** who aren’t of noble birth.
ochre-jelly.special.1.name: Amorphous
ochre-jelly.special.1.desc: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
ochre-jelly.special.2.name: Spider Climb
ochre-jelly.special.2.desc: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
ochre-jelly.actions.1.name: Pseudopod
ochre-jelly.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.
ochre-jelly.reactions.1.name: Split
ochre-jelly.reactions.1.desc: When a jelly that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new jellies if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new jelly has hit points equal to half the original jelly's, rounded down. New jellies are one size smaller than the original jelly.
ochre-jelly.name: Ochre Jelly
octopus.special.1.name: Hold Breath
octopus.special.1.desc: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
octopus.special.2.name: Underwater Camouflage
octopus.special.2.desc: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.
octopus.special.3.name: Water Breathing
octopus.special.3.desc: The octopus can breathe only underwater.
octopus.actions.1.name: Tentacles
octopus.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends, the octopus can't use its tentacles on another target.
octopus.actions.2.name: Ink Cloud
octopus.actions.2.desc: A 5-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the octopus if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action.
octopus.name: Octopus
ogre.actions.1.name: Greatclub
ogre.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
ogre.actions.2.name: Javelin
ogre.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
ogre.name: Ogre
ogre-zombie.special.1.name: Undead Fortitude
ogre-zombie.special.1.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
ogre-zombie.actions.1.name: Morningstar
ogre-zombie.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
ogre-zombie.name: Ogre Zombie
ogre-zombie.languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak
oni.special.1.name: Innate Spellcasting
oni.special.1.desc:
The oni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). The oni can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: darkness, invisibility
1/day each: charm person, cone of cold, gaseous form, sleep
oni.special.2.name: Magic Weapons
oni.special.2.desc: The oni's weapon attacks are magical.
oni.special.3.name: Regeneration
oni.special.3.desc: The oni regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.
oni.actions.1.name: Multiattack
oni.actions.1.desc: The oni makes two attacks, either with its claws or its glaive.
oni.actions.2.name: Claw (Oni Form Only)
oni.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
oni.actions.3.name: Glaive
oni.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage in Small or Medium form.
oni.actions.4.name: Change Shape
oni.actions.4.desc: The oni magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid, into a Large giant, or back into its true form. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. The only equipment that is transformed is its glaive, which shrinks so that it can be wielded in humanoid form. If the oni dies, it reverts to its true form, and its glaive reverts to its normal size.
oni.name: Oni
orc.special.1.name: Aggressive
orc.special.1.desc: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.
orc.actions.1.name: Greataxe
orc.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.
orc.actions.2.name: Javelin
orc.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
orc.name: Orc
otyugh.special.1.name: Limited Telepathy
otyugh.special.1.desc: The otyugh can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 ft. of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.
otyugh.actions.1.name: Multiattack
otyugh.actions.1.desc: The otyugh makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.
otyugh.actions.2.name: Bite
otyugh.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.
otyugh.actions.3.name: Tentacle
otyugh.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained until the grapple ends. The otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.
otyugh.actions.4.name: Tentacle Slam
otyugh.actions.4.desc: The otyugh slams creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the otyugh's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.
otyugh.name: Otyugh
owl.special.1.name: Flyby
owl.special.1.desc: The owl doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
owl.special.2.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
owl.special.2.desc: The owl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.
owl.actions.1.name: Talons
owl.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.
owl.name: Owl
owlbear.special.1.name: Keen Sight and Smell
owlbear.special.1.desc: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.
owlbear.actions.1.name: Multiattack
owlbear.actions.1.desc: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.
owlbear.actions.2.name: Beak
owlbear.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.
owlbear.actions.3.name: Claws
owlbear.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.
owlbear.name: Owlbear
panther.special.1.name: Keen Smell
panther.special.1.desc: The panther has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
panther.special.2.name: Pounce
panther.special.2.desc: If the panther moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the panther can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
panther.actions.1.name: Bite
panther.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
panther.actions.2.name: Claw
panther.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
panther.name: Panther
pegasus.actions.1.name: Hooves
pegasus.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.languages: understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak
phase-spider.special.1.name: Ethereal Jaunt
phase-spider.special.1.desc: As a bonus action, the spider can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.
phase-spider.special.2.name: Spider Climb
phase-spider.special.2.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
phase-spider.special.3.name: Web Walker
phase-spider.special.3.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
phase-spider.actions.1.name: Bite
phase-spider.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.
phase-spider.name: Phase Spider
phase-spider.desc: A phase spider possesses the magical ability to phase in and out of the Ethereal Plane. It seems to appear out of nowhere and quickly vanishes after attacking. Its movement on the Ethereal Plane before coming back to the Material Plane makes it seem like it can teleport.
pit-fiend.special.1.name: Fear Aura
pit-fiend.special.1.desc: Any creature hostile to the pit fiend that starts its turn within 20 feet of the pit fiend must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw, unless the pit fiend is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the pit fiend's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.
pit-fiend.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
pit-fiend.special.2.desc: The pit fiend has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
pit-fiend.special.3.name: Magic Weapons
pit-fiend.special.3.desc: The pit fiend's weapon attacks are magical.
pit-fiend.special.4.name: Innate Spellcasting
pit-fiend.special.4.desc:
The pit fiend's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 21). The pit fiend can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, fireball
3/day each: hold monster, wall of fire
pit-fiend.actions.1.name: Multiattack
pit-fiend.actions.1.desc: The pit fiend makes four attacks: one with its bite, one with its claw, one with its mace, and one with its tail.
pit-fiend.actions.2.name: Bite
pit-fiend.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the target can't regain hit points, and it takes 21 (6d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
pit-fiend.actions.3.name: Claw
pit-fiend.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.
pit-fiend.actions.4.name: Mace
pit-fiend.actions.4.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage.
pit-fiend.actions.5.name: Tail
pit-fiend.actions.5.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
pit-fiend.name: Pit Fiend
pit-fiend.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered
planetar.special.1.name: Angelic Weapons
planetar.special.1.desc: The planetar's weapon attacks are magical. When the planetar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 5d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).
planetar.special.2.name: Divine Awareness
planetar.special.2.desc: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.
planetar.special.3.name: Innate Spellcasting
planetar.special.3.desc:
The planetar's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). The planetar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect evil and good, invisibility (self only)
3/day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, flame strike, raise dead
1/day each: commune, control weather, insect plague
planetar.special.4.name: Magic Resistance
planetar.special.4.desc: The planetar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
planetar.actions.1.name: Multiattack
planetar.actions.1.desc: The planetar makes two melee attacks.
planetar.actions.2.name: Greatsword
planetar.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.
planetar.actions.3.name: Healing Touch
planetar.actions.3.desc: The planetar touches another creature. The target magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.
planetar.name: Planetar
planetar.resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
plesiosaurus.special.1.name: Hold Breath
plesiosaurus.special.1.desc: The plesiosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.
plesiosaurus.actions.1.name: Bite
plesiosaurus.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.
plesiosaurus.name: Plesiosaurus
poisonous-snake.actions.1.name: Bite
poisonous-snake.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
poisonous-snake.name: Poisonous Snake
polar-bear.special.1.name: Keen Smell
polar-bear.special.1.desc: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
polar-bear.actions.1.name: Multiattack
polar-bear.actions.1.desc: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
polar-bear.actions.2.name: Bite
polar-bear.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.
polar-bear.actions.3.name: Claws
polar-bear.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
polar-bear.name: Polar Bear
pony.actions.1.name: Hooves
pony.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
pony.name: Pony
priest.special.1.name: Divine Eminence
priest.special.1.desc: As a bonus action, the priest can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If the priest expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.
priest.special.2.name: Spellcasting
priest.special.2.desc:
The priest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The priest has the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary
- 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon
- 3rd level (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians
priest.actions.1.name: Mace
priest.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.
priest.name: Priest
priest.desc:
Priests bring the teachings of their gods to the common folk. They are the spiritual leaders of temples and shrines and often hold positions of influence in their communities. Evil priests might work openly under a tyrant, or they might be the leaders of religious sects hidden in the shadows of good society, overseeing depraved rites.

A priest typically has one or more acolytes to help with religious ceremonies and other sacred duties.
pseudodragon.special.1.name: Keen Senses
pseudodragon.special.1.desc: The pseudodragon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.
pseudodragon.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
pseudodragon.special.2.desc: The pseudodragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
pseudodragon.special.3.name: Limited Telepathy
pseudodragon.special.3.desc: The pseudodragon can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 ft. of it that can understand a language.
pseudodragon.actions.1.name: Bite
pseudodragon.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
pseudodragon.actions.2.name: Sting
pseudodragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target falls unconscious for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake.
pseudodragon.name: Pseudodragon
pseudodragon.languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak
purple-worm.special.1.name: Tunneler
purple-worm.special.1.desc: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.
purple-worm.actions.1.name: Multiattack
purple-worm.actions.1.desc: The worm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.
purple-worm.actions.2.name: Bite
purple-worm.actions.2.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.
If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.
purple-worm.actions.3.name: Tail Stinger
purple-worm.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
purple-worm.name: Purple Worm
quasit.special.1.name: Shapechanger
quasit.special.1.desc: The quasit can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a bat (speed 10 ft. fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., swim 40 ft.), or back into its true form . Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed . It reverts to its true form if it dies.
quasit.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
quasit.special.2.desc: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
quasit.actions.1.name: Claw (Bite in Beast Form)
quasit.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
quasit.actions.2.name: Scare
quasit.actions.2.desc: One creature of the quasit's choice within 20 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the quasit is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success.
quasit.actions.3.name: Invisibility
quasit.actions.3.desc: The quasit magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Scare, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the quasit wears or carries is invisible with it.
quasit.name: Quasit
quasit.resistances: cold; fire; lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
quipper.special.1.name: Blood Frenzy
quipper.special.1.desc: The quipper has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.
quipper.special.2.name: Water Breathing
quipper.special.2.desc: The quipper can breathe only underwater.
quipper.actions.1.name: Bite
quipper.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
quipper.name: Quipper
quipper.desc: A quipper is a carnivorous fish with sharp teeth. Quippers can adapt to any aquatic environment, including cold subterranean lakes. They frequently gather in swarms; the statistics for a swarm of quippers appear later in this appendix.
rakshasa.special.1.name: Limited Magic Immunity
rakshasa.special.1.desc: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.
rakshasa.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
rakshasa.special.2.desc:
The rakshasa's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The rakshasa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect thoughts, disguise self, mage hand, minor illusion
3/day each: charm person, detect magic, invisibility, major image, suggestion
1/day each: dominate person, fly, plane shift, true seeing
rakshasa.actions.1.name: Multiattack
rakshasa.actions.1.desc: The rakshasa makes two claw attacks
rakshasa.actions.2.name: Claw
rakshasa.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is cursed if it is a creature. The magical curse takes effect whenever the target takes a short or long rest, filling the target's thoughts with horrible images and dreams. The cursed target gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. The curse lasts until it is lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.
rakshasa.name: Rakshasa
rakshasa.vulnerabilities: piercing from magic weapons wielded by good creatures
rakshasa.immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
rat.special.1.name: Keen Smell
rat.special.1.desc: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
rat.actions.1.name: Bite
rat.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
rat.name: Rat
raven.special.1.name: Mimicry
raven.special.1.desc: The raven can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.
raven.actions.1.name: Beak
raven.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
raven.name: Raven
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Bite
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Fire Breath
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc: The dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
red-dragon-wyrmling.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
reef-shark.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
reef-shark.special.1.desc: The shark has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
reef-shark.special.2.name: Water Breathing
reef-shark.special.2.desc: The shark can breathe only underwater.
reef-shark.actions.1.name: Bite
reef-shark.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
reef-shark.name: Reef Shark
reef-shark.desc: Smaller than giant sharks and hunter sharks, reef sharks inhabit shallow waters and coral reefs, gathering in small packs to hunt. A full-grown specimen measures 6 to 10 feet long.
remorhaz.special.1.name: Heated Body
remorhaz.special.1.desc: A creature that touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.
remorhaz.actions.1.name: Bite
remorhaz.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the remorhaz can't bite another target.
remorhaz.actions.2.name: Swallow
remorhaz.actions.2.desc:
The remorhaz makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.
If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the remorhaz. If the remorhaz dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.
remorhaz.name: Remorhaz
rhinoceros.special.1.name: Charge
rhinoceros.special.1.desc: If the rhinoceros moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
rhinoceros.actions.1.name: Gore
rhinoceros.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
rhinoceros.name: Rhinoceros
riding-horse.actions.1.name: Hooves
riding-horse.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
riding-horse.name: Riding Horse
roc.special.1.name: Keen Sight
roc.special.1.desc: The roc has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
roc.actions.1.name: Multiattack
roc.actions.1.desc: The roc makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.
roc.actions.2.name: Beak
roc.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage.
roc.actions.3.name: Talons
roc.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the roc can't use its talons on another target.
roc.name: Roc
roper.special.1.name: False Appearance
roper.special.1.desc: While the roper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.
roper.special.2.name: Grasping Tendrils
roper.special.2.desc: The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. A tendril can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 15 Strength check against it.
roper.special.3.name: Spider Climb
roper.special.3.desc: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
roper.actions.1.name: Multiattack
roper.actions.1.desc: The roper makes four attacks with its tendrils, uses Reel, and makes one attack with its bite.
roper.actions.2.name: Bite
roper.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage.
roper.actions.3.name: Tendril
roper.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 50 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and the roper can't use the same tendril on another target.
roper.actions.4.name: Reel
roper.actions.4.desc: The roper pulls each creature grappled by it up to 25 ft. straight toward it.
roper.name: Roper
rug-of-smothering.special.1.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
rug-of-smothering.special.1.desc: The rug is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the rug must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.
rug-of-smothering.special.2.name: Damage Transfer
rug-of-smothering.special.2.desc: While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature grappled by the rug takes the other half.
rug-of-smothering.special.3.name: False Appearance
rug-of-smothering.special.3.desc: While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.
rug-of-smothering.actions.1.name: Smother
rug-of-smothering.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, blinded, and at risk of suffocating, and the rug can't smother another target. In addition, at the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
rug-of-smothering.name: Rug of Smothering
rust-monster.special.1.name: Iron Scent
rust-monster.special.1.desc: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.
rust-monster.special.2.name: Rust Metal
rust-monster.special.2.desc: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the rust monster is destroyed after dealing damage.
rust-monster.actions.1.name: Bite
rust-monster.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
rust-monster.actions.2.name: Antennae
rust-monster.actions.2.desc:
The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.
If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, its takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.
rust-monster.name: Rust Monster
saber-toothed-tiger.special.1.name: Keen Smell
saber-toothed-tiger.special.1.desc: The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
saber-toothed-tiger.special.2.name: Pounce
saber-toothed-tiger.special.2.desc: If the tiger moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
saber-toothed-tiger.actions.1.name: Bite
saber-toothed-tiger.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.
saber-toothed-tiger.actions.2.name: Claw
saber-toothed-tiger.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
saber-toothed-tiger.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
sahuagin.special.1.name: Blood Frenzy
sahuagin.special.1.desc: The sahuagin has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.
sahuagin.special.2.name: Limited Amphibiousness
sahuagin.special.2.desc: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.
sahuagin.special.3.name: Shark Telepathy
sahuagin.special.3.desc: The sahuagin can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.
sahuagin.actions.1.name: Multiattack
sahuagin.actions.1.desc: The sahuagin makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or spear.
sahuagin.actions.2.name: Bite
sahuagin.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.
sahuagin.actions.3.name: Claws
sahuagin.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.
sahuagin.actions.4.name: Spear
sahuagin.actions.4.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
sahuagin.name: Sahuagin
salamander.special.1.name: Heated Body
salamander.special.1.desc: A creature that touches the salamander or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.
salamander.special.2.name: Heated Weapons
salamander.special.2.desc: Any metal melee weapon the salamander wields deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage on a hit (included in the attack).
salamander.actions.1.name: Multiattack
salamander.actions.1.desc: The salamander makes two attacks: one with its spear and one with its tail.
salamander.actions.2.name: Spear
