salamander.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
salamander.actions.3.name: Tail
salamander.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the salamander can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the salamander can't make tail attacks against other targets.
salamander.name: Salamander
salamander.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
satyr.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
satyr.special.1.desc: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
satyr.actions.1.name: Ram
satyr.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
satyr.actions.2.name: Shortsword
satyr.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
satyr.actions.3.name: Shortbow
satyr.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
satyr.name: Satyr
scorpion.actions.1.name: Sting
scorpion.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
scorpion.name: Scorpion
scout.special.1.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
scout.special.1.desc: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.
scout.actions.1.name: Multiattack
scout.actions.1.desc: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.
scout.actions.2.name: Shortsword
scout.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
scout.actions.3.name: Longbow
scout.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
scout.name: Scout
scout.desc: Scouts are skilled hunters and trackers who offer their services for a fee. Most hunt wild game, but a few work as bounty hunters, serve as guides, or provide military reconnaissance.
sea-hag.special.1.name: Amphibious
sea-hag.special.1.desc: The hag can breathe air and water.
sea-hag.special.2.name: Horrific Appearance
sea-hag.special.2.desc:
Any humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the hag is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the hag's Horrific Appearance for the next 24 hours.
Unless the target is surprised or the revelation of the hag's true form is sudden, the target can avert its eyes and avoid making the initial saving throw. Until the start of its next turn, a creature that averts its eyes has disadvantage on attack rolls against the hag.
sea-hag.actions.1.name: Claws
sea-hag.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sea-hag.actions.2.name: Death Glare
sea-hag.actions.2.desc: The hag targets one frightened creature she can see within 30 ft. of her. If the target can see the hag, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or drop to 0 hit points.
sea-hag.actions.3.name: Illusory Appearance
sea-hag.actions.3.desc:
The hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like an ugly creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The effect ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.
The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the hag could appear to have no claws, but someone touching her hand might feel the claws. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the hag is disguised.
sea-hag.name: Sea Hag
sea-horse.special.1.name: Water Breathing
sea-horse.special.1.desc: The sea horse can breathe only underwater.
sea-horse.name: Sea Horse
shadow.special.1.name: Amorphous
shadow.special.1.desc: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
shadow.special.2.name: Shadow Stealth
shadow.special.2.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Its stealth bonus is also improved to +6.
shadow.special.3.name: Sunlight Weakness
shadow.special.3.desc: While in sunlight, the shadow has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.
shadow.actions.1.name: Strength Drain
shadow.actions.1.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.
If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.
shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.resistances: acid; cold; fire; lightning; thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
shambling-mound.special.1.name: Lightning Absorption
shambling-mound.special.1.desc: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.
shambling-mound.actions.1.name: Multiattack
shambling-mound.actions.1.desc: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.
shambling-mound.actions.2.name: Slam
shambling-mound.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
shambling-mound.actions.3.name: Engulf
shambling-mound.actions.3.desc: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.
shambling-mound.name: Shambling Mound
shield-guardian.special.1.name: Bound
shield-guardian.special.1.desc: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.
shield-guardian.special.2.name: Regeneration
shield-guardian.special.2.desc: The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit. point.
shield-guardian.special.3.name: Spell Storing
shield-guardian.special.3.desc: A spellcaster who wears the shield guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the guardian casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost.
shield-guardian.actions.1.name: Multiattack
shield-guardian.actions.1.desc: The guardian makes two fist attacks.
shield-guardian.actions.2.name: Fist
shield-guardian.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
shield-guardian.reactions.1.name: Shield
shield-guardian.reactions.1.desc: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the guardian's amulet, the guardian grants a +2 bonus to the wearer's AC if the guardian is within 5 feet of the wearer.
shield-guardian.name: Shield Guardian
shield-guardian.languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak
shrieker.special.1.name: False Appearance
shrieker.special.1.desc: While the shrieker remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.
shrieker.reactions.1.name: Shriek
shrieker.reactions.1.desc: When bright light or a creature is within 30 feet of the shrieker, it emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of it. The shrieker continues to shriek until the disturbance moves out of range and for 1d4 of the shrieker's turns afterward
shrieker.name: Shrieker
silver-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Bite
silver-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
silver-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Breath Weapons
silver-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Cold Breath. The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Paralyzing Breath. The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
silver-dragon-wyrmling.name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
skeleton.actions.1.name: Shortsword
skeleton.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
skeleton.actions.2.name: Shortbow
skeleton.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.languages: understands all languages it spoke in life but can't speak
solar.special.1.name: Angelic Weapons
solar.special.1.desc: The solar's weapon attacks are magical. When the solar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).
solar.special.2.name: Divine Awareness
solar.special.2.desc: The solar knows if it hears a lie.
solar.special.3.name: Innate Spellcasting
solar.special.3.desc:
The solar's spell casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect evil and good, invisibility (self only)
3/day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, resurrection
1/day each: commune, control weather
solar.special.4.name: Magic Resistance
solar.special.4.desc: The solar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
solar.actions.1.name: Multiattack
solar.actions.1.desc: The solar makes two greatsword attacks.
solar.actions.2.name: Greatsword
solar.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage.
solar.actions.3.name: Slaying Longbow
solar.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature that has 190 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die.
solar.actions.4.name: Flying Sword
solar.actions.4.desc: The solar releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of it. If the solar can see the sword, the solar can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 ft. and either make one attack against a target or return to the solar's hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the solar is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if the solar dies.
solar.actions.5.name: Healing Touch
solar.actions.5.desc: The solar touches another creature. The target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.
solar.legendary.1.name: Teleport
solar.legendary.1.desc: The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.
solar.legendary.2.name: Searing Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
solar.legendary.2.desc: The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
solar.legendary.3.name: Blinding Gaze (Costs 3 Actions)
solar.legendary.3.desc: The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 ft. of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.
solar.name: Solar
solar.resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
specter.special.1.name: Incorporeal Movement
specter.special.1.desc: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
specter.special.2.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
specter.special.2.desc: While in sunlight, the specter has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
specter.actions.1.name: Life Drain
specter.actions.1.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.
specter.name: Specter
specter.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
specter.resistances: acid; cold; fire; lightning; thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
spider.special.1.name: Spider Climb
spider.special.1.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
spider.special.2.name: Web Sense
spider.special.2.desc: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
spider.special.3.name: Web Walker
spider.special.3.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
spider.actions.1.name: Bite
spider.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) poison damage.
spider.name: Spider
spirit-naga.special.1.name: Rejuvenation
spirit-naga.special.1.desc: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.
spirit-naga.special.2.name: Spellcasting
spirit-naga.special.2.desc:
The naga is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks), and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells. It has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): mage hand, minor illusion, ray of frost
- 1st level (4 slots): charm person, detect magic, sleep
- 2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, hold person
- 3rd level (3 slots): lightning bolt, water breathing
- 4th level (3 slots): blight, dimension door
- 5th level (2 slots): dominate person
spirit-naga.actions.1.name: Bite
spirit-naga.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
spirit-naga.name: Spirit Naga
sprite.actions.1.name: Longsword
sprite.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.
sprite.actions.2.name: Shortbow
sprite.actions.2.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. If its saving throw result is 5 or lower, the poisoned target falls unconscious for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
sprite.actions.3.name: Heart Sight
sprite.actions.3.desc: The sprite touches a creature and magically knows the creature's current emotional state. If the target fails a DC 10 Charisma saving throw, the sprite also knows the creature's alignment. Celestials, fiends, and undead automatically fail the saving throw.
sprite.actions.4.name: Invisibility
sprite.actions.4.desc: The sprite magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the sprite wears or carries is invisible with it.
sprite.name: Sprite
spy.special.1.name: Cunning Action
spy.special.1.desc: On each of its turns, the spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
spy.special.2.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
spy.special.2.desc: The spy deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the spy that isn't incapacitated and the spy doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.
spy.actions.1.name: Multiattack
spy.actions.1.desc: The spy makes two melee attacks.
spy.actions.2.name: Shortsword
spy.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
spy.actions.3.name: Hand Crossbow
spy.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
spy.name: Spy
spy.desc: Rulers, nobles, merchants, guildmasters, and other wealthy individuals use spies to gain the upper hand in a world of cutthroat politics. A spy is trained to secretly gather information. Loyal spies would rather die than divulge information that could compromise them or their employers.
steam-mephit.special.1.name: Death Burst
steam-mephit.special.1.desc: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a cloud of steam. Each creature within 5 ft. of the mephit must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 4 (1d8) fire damage.
steam-mephit.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
steam-mephit.special.2.desc: The mephit can innately cast blur, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.
steam-mephit.actions.1.name: Claws
steam-mephit.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.
steam-mephit.actions.2.name: Steam Breath
steam-mephit.actions.2.desc: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of scalding steam. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
steam-mephit.name: Steam Mephit
stirge.actions.1.name: Blood Drain
stirge.actions.1.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the stirge's turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points due to blood loss.
The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 10 hit points of blood from the target or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the stirge.
stirge.name: Stirge
stone-giant.special.1.name: Stone Camouflage
stone-giant.special.1.desc: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.
stone-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
stone-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.
stone-giant.actions.2.name: Greatclub
stone-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
stone-giant.actions.3.name: Rock
stone-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
stone-giant.reactions.1.name: Rock Catching
stone-giant.reactions.1.desc: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can, with a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.
stone-giant.name: Stone Giant
stone-golem.special.1.name: Immutable Form
stone-golem.special.1.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.
stone-golem.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
stone-golem.special.2.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
stone-golem.special.3.name: Magic Weapons
stone-golem.special.3.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.
stone-golem.actions.1.name: Multiattack
stone-golem.actions.1.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.
stone-golem.actions.2.name: Slam
stone-golem.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
stone-golem.actions.3.name: Slow
stone-golem.actions.3.desc: The golem targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 ft. of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
stone-golem.name: Stone Golem
stone-golem.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
stone-golem.immunities: poison; psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
storm-giant.special.1.name: Amphibious
storm-giant.special.1.desc: The giant can breathe air and water.
storm-giant.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
storm-giant.special.2.desc:
The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect magic, feather fall, levitate, light
3/day each: control weather, water breathing
storm-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
storm-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two greatsword attacks.
storm-giant.actions.2.name: Greatsword
storm-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (6d6 + 9) slashing damage.
storm-giant.actions.3.name: Rock
storm-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
storm-giant.actions.4.name: Lightning Strike
storm-giant.actions.4.desc: The giant hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
storm-giant.name: Storm Giant
succubus-incubus.special.1.name: Telepathic Bond
succubus-incubus.special.1.desc: The fiend ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has charmed. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence.
succubus-incubus.special.2.name: Shapechanger
succubus-incubus.special.2.desc: The fiend can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Without wings, the fiend loses its flying speed. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
succubus-incubus.actions.1.name: Claw (Fiend Form Only)
succubus-incubus.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
succubus-incubus.actions.2.name: Charm
succubus-incubus.actions.2.desc:
One humanoid the fiend can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target obeys the fiend's verbal or telepathic commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this fiend's Charm for the next 24 hours.
The fiend can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.
succubus-incubus.actions.3.name: Draining Kiss
succubus-incubus.actions.3.desc: The fiend kisses a creature charmed by it or a willing creature. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.
succubus-incubus.actions.4.name: Etherealness
succubus-incubus.actions.4.desc: The fiend magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.
succubus-incubus.name: Succubus/Incubus
succubus-incubus.resistances: cold; fire; lightning; poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
swarm-of-bats.special.1.name: Echolocation
swarm-of-bats.special.1.desc: The swarm can't use its blindsight while deafened.
swarm-of-bats.special.2.name: Keen Hearing
swarm-of-bats.special.2.desc: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
swarm-of-bats.special.3.name: Swarm
swarm-of-bats.special.3.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
swarm-of-bats.actions.1.name: Bites
swarm-of-bats.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 5 (2d4) piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
swarm-of-bats.name: Swarm of Bats
swarm-of-beetles.special.1.name: Swarm
swarm-of-beetles.special.1.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
swarm-of-beetles.actions.1.name: Bites
swarm-of-beetles.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
swarm-of-beetles.name: Swarm of Beetles
swarm-of-centipedes.special.1.name: Swarm
swarm-of-centipedes.special.1.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
swarm-of-centipedes.actions.1.name: Bites
swarm-of-centipedes.actions.1.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by a swarm of centipedes is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

swarm-of-poisonous-snakes.actions.1.name: Bites

Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage, or 3 (1d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
swarm-of-poisonous-snakes.name: Swarm of Poisonous Snakes
swarm-of-quippers.special.1.name: Blood Frenzy
swarm-of-quippers.special.1.desc: The swarm has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.
swarm-of-quippers.special.2.name: Swarm
swarm-of-quippers.special.2.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny quipper. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
swarm-of-quippers.special.3.name: Water Breathing
swarm-of-quippers.special.3.desc: The swarm can breathe only underwater.
swarm-of-quippers.actions.1.name: Bites
swarm-of-quippers.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
swarm-of-quippers.name: Swarm of Quippers
swarm-of-rats.special.1.name: Keen Smell
swarm-of-rats.special.1.desc: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

swarm-of-ravens.actions.1.name: Beaks
swarm-of-ravens.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage, or 3 (1d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
swarm-of-ravens.name: Swarm of Ravens

swarm-of-spiders.special.2.name: Spider Climb
swarm-of-spiders.special.2.desc: The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
swarm-of-spiders.special.3.name: Web Sense
swarm-of-spiders.special.3.desc: While in contact with a web, the swarm knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
swarm-of-spiders.special.4.name: Web Walker
swarm-of-spiders.special.4.desc: The swarm ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

swarm-of-wasps.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

tarrasque.special.1.name: Legendary Resistance
tarrasque.special.1.desc: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
tarrasque.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
tarrasque.special.2.desc: The tarrasque has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
tarrasque.special.3.name: Reflective Carapace
tarrasque.special.3.desc: Any time the tarrasque is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the tarrasque, turning the caster into the target.
tarrasque.special.4.name: Siege Monster
tarrasque.special.4.desc: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.
tarrasque.actions.1.name: Multiattack
tarrasque.actions.1.desc: The tarrasque can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its Swallow instead of its bite.
tarrasque.actions.2.name: Bite
tarrasque.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tarrasque can't bite another target.
tarrasque.actions.3.name: Claw
tarrasque.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) slashing damage.
tarrasque.actions.4.name: Horns
tarrasque.actions.4.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) piercing damage.
tarrasque.actions.5.name: Tail
tarrasque.actions.5.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
tarrasque.actions.6.name: Frightful Presence
tarrasque.actions.6.desc: Each creature of the tarrasque's choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the tarrasque's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.
tarrasque.actions.7.name: Swallow
tarrasque.actions.7.desc:
The tarrasque makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns.
If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque. If the tarrasque dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.
tarrasque.legendary.1.name: Attack
tarrasque.legendary.1.desc: The tarrasque makes one claw attack or tail attack.
tarrasque.legendary.2.name: Move
tarrasque.legendary.2.desc: The tarrasque moves up to half its speed.
tarrasque.legendary.3.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
tarrasque.legendary.3.desc: The tarrasque makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.
tarrasque.name: Tarrasque
tarrasque.immunities: fire; poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
thug.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
thug.special.1.desc: The thug has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the thug's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
thug.actions.1.name: Multiattack
thug.actions.1.desc: The thug makes two melee attacks.
thug.actions.2.name: Mace
thug.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
thug.actions.3.name: Heavy Crossbow
thug.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.
thug.name: Thug
thug.desc: Thugs are ruthless enforcers skilled at intimidation and violence. They work for money and have few scruples.
tiger.special.1.name: Keen Smell
tiger.special.1.desc: The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
tiger.special.2.name: Pounce
tiger.special.2.desc: If the tiger moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
tiger.actions.1.name: Bite
tiger.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
tiger.actions.2.name: Claw
tiger.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
tiger.name: Tiger
treant.special.1.name: False Appearance
treant.special.1.desc: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.
treant.special.2.name: Siege Monster
treant.special.2.desc: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.
treant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
treant.actions.1.desc: The treant makes two slam attacks.
treant.actions.2.name: Slam
treant.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
treant.actions.3.name: Rock
treant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
treant.actions.4.name: Animate Trees
treant.actions.4.desc: The treant magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as a treant, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the Slam action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of the treant. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.
treant.name: Treant
tribal-warrior.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
tribal-warrior.special.1.desc: The warrior has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the warrior's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
tribal-warrior.actions.1.name: Spear
tribal-warrior.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
tribal-warrior.name: Tribal Warrior
tribal-warrior.desc: Tribal warriors live beyond civilization, most often subsisting on fishing and hunting. Each tribe acts in accordance with the wishes of its chief, who is the greatest or oldest warrior of the tribe or a tribe member blessed by the gods.
triceratops.special.1.name: Trampling Charge
triceratops.special.1.desc: If the triceratops moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the triceratops can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.
triceratops.actions.1.name: Gore
triceratops.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage.
triceratops.actions.2.name: Stomp
triceratops.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage
triceratops.name: Triceratops
troll.special.1.name: Keen Smell
troll.special.1.desc: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
troll.special.2.name: Regeneration
troll.special.2.desc: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.
troll.actions.1.name: Multiattack
troll.actions.1.desc: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
troll.actions.2.name: Bite
troll.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
troll.actions.3.name: Claw
troll.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
troll.name: Troll
tyrannosaurus-rex.actions.1.name: Multiattack
tyrannosaurus-rex.actions.1.desc: The tyrannosaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.
tyrannosaurus-rex.actions.2.name: Bite
tyrannosaurus-rex.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tyrannosaurus can't bite another target.
tyrannosaurus-rex.actions.3.name: Tail
tyrannosaurus-rex.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
tyrannosaurus-rex.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
unicorn.special.1.name: Charge
unicorn.special.1.desc: If the unicorn moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
unicorn.special.2.name: Innate Spellcasting
unicorn.special.2.desc:
The unicorn's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The unicorn can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

At will: detect evil and good, druidcraft, pass without trace
1/day each: calm emotions, dispel evil and good, entangle
unicorn.special.3.name: Magic Resistance
unicorn.special.3.desc: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
unicorn.special.4.name: Magic Weapons
unicorn.special.4.desc: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.
unicorn.actions.1.name: Multiattack
unicorn.actions.1.desc: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn.
unicorn.actions.2.name: Hooves
unicorn.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
unicorn.actions.3.name: Horn
unicorn.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
unicorn.actions.4.name: Healing Touch
unicorn.actions.4.desc: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn. The target magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.
unicorn.actions.5.name: Teleport
unicorn.actions.5.desc: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 ft. of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.
unicorn.legendary.1.name: Hooves
unicorn.legendary.1.desc: The unicorn makes one attack with its hooves.
unicorn.legendary.2.name: Shimmering Shield (Costs 2 Actions)
unicorn.legendary.2.desc: The unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 ft. of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.
unicorn.legendary.3.name: Heal Self (Costs 3 Actions)
unicorn.legendary.3.desc: The unicorn magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points.
unicorn.name: Unicorn
vampire-vampire.special.1.name: Shapechanger
vampire-vampire.special.1.desc:
If the vampire isn't in sun light or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.
While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.
vampire-vampire.special.2.name: Legendary Resistance
vampire-vampire.special.2.desc: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
vampire-vampire.special.3.name: Misty Escape
vampire-vampire.special.3.desc:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.
While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.
vampire-vampire.special.4.name: Regeneration
vampire-vampire.special.4.desc: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.
vampire-vampire.special.5.name: Spider Climb
vampire-vampire.special.5.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
vampire-vampire.special.6.name: Vampire Weaknesses
vampire-vampire.special.6.desc:
The vampire has the following flaws:
Forbiddance. The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
Harmed by Running Water. The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is incapacitated in its resting place, the vampire is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
vampire-vampire.actions.1.name: Multiattack
vampire-vampire.actions.1.desc: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.
vampire-vampire.actions.2.name: Unarmed Strike
vampire-vampire.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 18).
vampire-vampire.actions.3.name: Bite
vampire-vampire.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.
vampire-vampire.actions.4.name: Charm
vampire-vampire.actions.4.desc:
The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 ft. of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bit attack.
Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.
vampire-vampire.actions.5.name: Children of the Night
vampire-vampire.actions.5.desc: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call 3d6 wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.
vampire-vampire.legendary.1.name: Move
vampire-vampire.legendary.1.desc: The vampire moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
vampire-vampire.legendary.2.name: Unarmed Strike
vampire-vampire.legendary.2.desc: The vampire makes one unarmed strike.
vampire-vampire.legendary.3.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
vampire-vampire.legendary.3.desc: The vampire makes one bite attack.
vampire-vampire.name: Vampire, Vampire Form
vampire-vampire.languages: the languages it knew in life
vampire-vampire.resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.
vampire-bat.actions.2.name: Charm
vampire-bat.actions.2.desc:
The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 ft. of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bit attack.
Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.
vampire-bat.actions.3.name: Children of the Night
vampire-bat.actions.3.desc: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call 3d6 wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.
vampire-bat.legendary.1.name: Move
vampire-bat.legendary.1.desc: The vampire moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
vampire-bat.legendary.2.name: Unarmed Strike
vampire-bat.legendary.2.desc: The vampire makes one unarmed strike.
vampire-bat.legendary.3.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
vampire-bat.legendary.3.desc: The vampire makes one bite attack.
vampire-bat.name: Vampire, Bat Form
vampire-bat.languages: the languages it knew in life
vampire-bat.resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
vampire-mist.special.1.name: Shapechanger
vampire-mist.special.1.desc:
If the vampire isn't in sun light or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.
While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.
vampire-mist.special.2.name: Legendary Resistance
vampire-mist.special.2.desc: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
vampire-mist.special.3.name: Misty Escape
vampire-mist.special.3.desc:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.
While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.
vampire-mist.special.4.name: Regeneration
vampire-mist.special.4.desc: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.
vampire-mist.special.5.name: Spider Climb
vampire-mist.special.5.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
vampire-mist.special.6.name: Vampire Weaknesses
vampire-mist.special.6.desc:
The vampire has the following flaws:
Forbiddance. The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
Harmed by Running Water. The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is incapacitated in its resting place, the vampire is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

Each creature in the elemental's space must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If it is Large or smaller, it is also grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. If the saving throw is successful, the target is pushed out of the elemental's space.
The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of the elemental's turns, each target grappled by it takes 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a DC 14 Strength and succeeding.

young-silver-dragon.actions.2.name: Bite
young-silver-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage.
young-silver-dragon.actions.3.name: Claw
young-silver-dragon.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
young-silver-dragon.actions.4.name: Breath Weapons
young-silver-dragon.actions.4.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Cold Breath. The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Paralyzing Breath. The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
young-silver-dragon.name: Young Silver Dragon
young-white-dragon.special.1.name: Ice Walk
young-white-dragon.special.1.desc: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.
young-white-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
young-white-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
young-white-dragon.actions.2.name: Bite
young-white-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.
young-white-dragon.actions.3.name: Claw
young-white-dragon.actions.3.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
young-white-dragon.actions.4.name: Cold Breath
young-white-dragon.actions.4.desc: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
young-white-dragon.name: Young White Dragon
zombie.special.1.name: Undead Fortitude
zombie.special.1.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
zombie.actions.1.name: Slam
zombie.actions.1.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.languages: understands all languages it spoke in life but can't speak
